【天富龍：簽訂募集資金專戶儲存五方監管協議】天富龍公告稱，公司此前獲准發行股票4001.00萬股，募集資金總額9.44億元，淨額8.56億元，其中超募6591.44萬元。公司擬將超募資金投入越南功能性環保綠色纖維專案（一期）。2026年6月9日，公司、天富龍新加坡實業、天富龍新加坡材料、招商銀行與保薦機構中信建投證券簽訂《募集資金專戶儲存五方監管協議》，明確各方權利義務，規範募集資金使用和管理。

【韓國議員與臺灣外事部門交流，外交部：已向韓方提出嚴正交涉】6月9日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。有外媒記者提問，臺灣“外交部”稱，8日韓國朝野三名國會議員與臺灣“外交部”政務處長會見，雙方就應對地緣政治挑戰、政經與文化交流、半導體與AI產業發展等交換了意見。中方如何看待這一交流？“臺灣是中國的一部分，沒有什麼‘外交部’。”林劍強調，中方一貫堅決反對建交國同中國臺灣地區進行任何形式的官方往來。1992年中韓建交時，雙方發表聯合公報，明確規定韓國承認中華人民共和國為代表中國的唯一合法政府，尊重中方只有一箇中國，臺灣是中國的一部分的立場。林劍指出，今年以來，韓方在多個場合公開重申，尊重一箇中國的立場沒有變化。中方已就此事向韓方提出了嚴正交涉，我們敦促韓方從中韓關係的大局出發，信守承諾，切實恪守一箇中國原則，不同臺灣地區開展任何形式的官方往來，不被“臺獨”分子利用，不向“臺獨”分裂勢力發出錯誤訊號，用實際行動維護雙邊關係健康穩定發展。（澎湃新聞）

【First-tier city rents up three months; Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen lead stabilization】Average rents for ordinary residences in China’s first-tier cities rose 0.16% MoM in May, the third consecutive monthly increase. On a Jan–May YoY basis, first-tier rents returned to modest growth of 0.21%, ending a two-year adjustment. Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen have driven the rebound, with residential rents climbing continuously since the March leasing season. Leasing fundamentals in first-tier cities are stabilizing, supported by concentrated high-quality industry and inflows of young workers.
【同方股份：子公司轉讓同方工業資訊科技80%股權完成工商變更】同方股份公告稱，為落實國資委要求，推進戰略轉型升級，公司透過產權交易所公開掛牌，轉讓全資子公司同方科創持有的同方工業資訊科技80%股權。北京淳中科技、其董事張峻峰、控股股東及實控人配偶劉佳麗摘牌受讓。截至公告披露日，股權轉讓已履行國有產權登記程式，完成工商變更，公司不再持有該股權，同方工業資訊科技不再納入合併報表範圍。

Steel Holds Decline Despite Strong China Exports — Steel rebar futures remained below CNY 3,140 per ton, hovering near six-week lows even after data showed China’s steel exports rose 8.8% in May from the previous month, supported by weak domestic demand and improved margins for overseas shipments. China exported 10.34 million metric tons of steel used in construction and manufacturing, the highest level since December. However, cumulative steel exports for the first five months of the year were down 8.1% from a year earlier amid growing trade protectionism from key overseas markets. Meanwhile, China’s steel market has entered its seasonally weak demand period earlier than usual this year due to persistent rainfall and the early arrival of summer heat. Construction activity typically slows during periods of heavy rain and high temperatures, weighing on demand for steel products.
【小米、張江高科入股力合算芯人工智慧產業創投企業】企查查APP顯示，近日，上海力合算芯人工智慧產業創業投資合夥企業（有限合夥）發生工商變更，新增小米關聯公司瀚星創業投資有限公司、張江高科全資子公司上海張江浩成創業投資有限公司等為合夥人。企查查資訊顯示，該企業成立於2026年3月，經營範圍包含：創業投資（限投資未上市企業）。

【北上深房租連漲三個月，一線城市走出“獨立行情”】在全國租房市場盤整之際，一線城市卻走出不一樣的行情。今年5月份，一線城市普通住宅的平均租金，環比上漲0.16%，已是連續三個月實現環比上漲。同比來看，今年前5月，一線城市平均租金結束連續兩年調整，轉為小幅上漲0.21%。北京、上海、深圳三大城市，成為本輪租房市場企穩的“領頭羊”。自今年3月租賃旺季以來，三城住宅租金持續上漲。一線城市依託優質產業資源與年輕就業人口，租賃基本面正率先企穩。（第一財經）

【State Taxation Administration: 47.111 mln business entities rated tax-credit compliant in 2026, +8.6% YoY】China's State Taxation Administration completed its 2026 tax-payment credit evaluations, covering 54.669 mln business entities, up 4.903 mln year-on-year. 47.111 mln entities were classified as tax-credit compliant, an 8.6% YoY rise. 18.154 mln entities proactively corrected errors to repair credit, up 4.178 mln (29.8% YoY); 3.881 mln of those achieved an upgraded credit rating after repair.
【劉浩凌不再擔任中投公司副董事長、總經理、首席投資官】6月9日，中投公司釋出兩則人事任命：經國務院決定，董事會審議透過，劉浩凌不再擔任中投公司副董事長、總經理、首席投資官職務。經董事會審議透過，聘任吳迎春為中投公司副總經理。

【日菲若一意孤行只會求錘得錘】6月9日下午，國防部新聞發言人張曉剛大校就近期涉軍問題釋出訊息。記者：據報道，日菲單方面宣佈啟動在中國臺灣島以東海域劃界談判，中國海警隨即位相關海域進行執法巡查，交通運輸部接續開展海上交通專項執法行動。請問對此有何評論？張曉剛：針對日菲擅自宣佈啟動中國臺灣島以東海域劃界談判，外交部已多次闡明堅決反對的嚴正立場。我們敦促日菲立即停止非法侵權挑釁行徑，若一意孤行只會求錘得錘，中方將以堅決有力的行動舉措維護國家領土主權和海洋權益。(國防部)

【China coast guard patrols east of Taiwan; foreign ministry warns Japan, Philippines against infringing China’s maritime rights】China’s Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian said on June 1 the China Coast Guard Daishan flotilla conducted law-enforcement patrols in waters east of Taiwan. Lin reiterated China claims an exclusive economic zone and continental shelf there and accused Japan and the Philippines of bypassing China by unilaterally initiating maritime delimitation talks, actions he said violate UNCLOS and basic international relations norms and seriously infringe China’s maritime rights. China will not permit such infringements.

【廣州國資累計盤活3800餘個專案，資產超650億元】廣州市國資委相關負責人表示，2025年以來深入推進“三資盤活”工作，累計盤活專案3800餘項、資產規模超650億元。由廣州交易集團牽頭搭建的“穗資雲”國資數字化平臺於今日正式上線，是廣州首個統一不動產全生命週期國有“三資”綜合管理服務平臺。（21財經）

European Stocks Rise on Tuesday — European stocks edged cautiously higher on Tuesday, with the STOXX 50 gaining 0.4% and the STOXX 600 advancing 0.2%. 【國防部：任何“倚外謀獨”“以武謀獨”的圖謀註定失敗】6月9日下午，國防部新聞發言人張曉剛大校就近期涉軍問題釋出訊息。 記者：據報道，臺灣防務部門負責人稱，美防長在香格里拉對話會主旨演說雖未提及臺灣，但臺會持續強化“自我防衛”能力，與美保持密切軍事合作，發揮臺維持“臺海和平穩定的責任與能力”。請問對此有何評論？ 張曉剛：“臺獨”與臺海和平水火不容，維護臺海和平穩定是中美雙方最大公約數。近來美方涉臺表態顯示其更加了解、重視中方在臺灣問題上的立場與關切，越來越多的事實印證中國終將統一也必將統一的大勢不可阻擋。任何“倚外謀獨”“以武謀獨”的圖謀註定失敗，執迷不悟、逆流而動的勢力都會被歷史洪流淹沒。

【Foreign Ministry urges Philippines to stop maritime infringements and provocative publicity】June 9 — Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian said at a routine briefing that Huangyan Island is China’s inherent territory and that China has indisputable sovereignty over the island and adjacent waters. 【U.S. requested China resume rare‑earth exports to Japan; China reiterates export controls on military end‑uses】June 9 — At a routine Foreign Ministry briefing, spokesman Lin Jian declined to confirm media reports that the U.S. has asked China to resume rare‑earth exports to Japan, saying such queries should be directed to the relevant Chinese authorities. He reiterated that China, under law and regulation, prohibits exports of dual‑use items to Japanese military users, military end‑uses or any other end‑users/uses that would enhance Japan’s military capability or assist attempts at nuclear armament.

【美方請求中方恢復對日稀土出口，外交部回應】6月9日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。彭博社記者提問，據日本經濟新聞報道，美方請求中國恢復對日本的稀土出口。請問中方對此有何評論？林劍表示，你問到的具體情況，建議向中方的主管部門瞭解。我要強調的是，中方依法依規針對所有兩用物項禁止對日本軍事使用者、軍事用途以及一切有助於提升日本軍事實力的其他終端使用者、用途出口，目的是制止日本“再軍事化”和擁核的企圖。（北京日報）

【騰訊、阿里等入股腦機介面研發商階梯醫療】天眼查App顯示，近日，上海階梯醫療科技有限公司發生工商變更，新增阿里巴巴旗下杭州灝月企業管理有限公司、騰訊旗下上海啟善投資有限公司等為股東，同時，註冊資本由100萬人民幣增至約300.6萬人民幣。該公司成立於2021年8月，法定代表人為張世強，經營範圍包括第二類醫療器械銷售、第二類醫療器械生產、第三類醫療器械生產等，現由趙鄭拓、李雪及上述新增股東等共同持股。官網顯示，該公司是一家專注於植入式腦機介面領域的創新型科技企業。

【U.S. Adds Alibaba, BYD to 'Military‑Related' List; China Urges Washington to Stop Unreasonable Suppression】Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian condemned a U.S. decision to place several Chinese companies, including Alibaba and BYD, on a 'military‑related' entities list, saying Washington is broadening national security grounds to create discriminatory lists and unreasonably suppress Chinese firms. He urged the U.S. to correct the action, stop the suppression, and warned China will take necessary measures to firmly safeguard the legitimate and lawful rights of its companies.
【外交部：敦促菲方停止海上侵權挑釁和煽宣炒作】外交部發言人林劍6月9日在例行記者會上就相關問題答問時表示，黃巖島是中國的固有領土，中國對黃巖島及附近海域擁有無可爭辯的主權。中國在黃巖島開展包括科考在內的任何活動，都是主權國家的正當權利。中方敦促菲律賓方面停止海上的侵權挑釁和煽宣炒作。（新華社）

【美方將阿里巴巴、比亞迪等列入“涉軍”清單，外交部：敦促美方停止無理打壓中企】6月9日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。法新社記者提問，美方將幾家中國企業，包括阿里巴巴、比亞迪等列入所謂“涉軍”企業清單，請問中方對此有何評論？林劍表示，中方一貫堅決反對美方泛化國家安全概念，劃設各類名目的歧視性清單，無理打壓中國企業。我們敦促美方糾正錯誤做法，停止對中國企業的無理打壓行徑。中方將採取必要措施，堅定維護中國企業的正當合法權益。（澎湃新聞）

【歐盟將允許軍艦檢查扣押俄羅斯油輪，外交部：一貫反對非法單邊制裁】6月9日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。今日俄羅斯（RT）記者提問，近日，‌歐盟外交與安全政策高階代表‌卡拉斯表示，歐盟將以油輪構成危險並旨在限制俄羅斯的能力為理由，允許其在地中海的軍艦檢查並扣押運輸俄羅斯石油的油輪。據報道，6月初，法國和英國海軍已經扣押了一艘從俄羅斯駛出的油輪，請問中方對此有何評論？這是否會影響國際能源運輸的正常秩序？林劍表示：“我們注意到了有關報道。中方一貫反對缺乏國際法依據、沒有聯合國安理會授權的非法單邊制裁，呼籲有關各方透過對話協商解決問題。”（澎湃新聞）

【中方這份報告獲國際人士稱讚，外交部：以人為核心的新型城鎮化建設成效顯著】6月9日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。記者提問，我們注意到，中國政府昨天釋出了《“以高質量城市發展助力落實聯合國2030年可持續發展議程”——中國落實〈新城市議程〉國家報告》。聯合國人居署執行主任羅斯巴赫等國際人士對此積極評價，認為中國城市發展經驗為全球南方國家提供了寶貴借鑑。請問發言人對此有何評論？林劍表示，今年是習近平主席提出全球發展倡議5週年，也是聯合國住房和城市可持續發展大會透過《新城市議程》10週年。中方釋出的這份報告，總結了中國落實《新城市議程》的積極成效，已向國際社會分享了中國推進城市可持續發展的實踐經驗。林劍指出，近年來，中國秉持習近平主席提出的人民城市重要理念，以人為核心的新型城鎮化建設成效顯著，城市空間佈局持續最佳化，配套功能日趨完善，人居環境愈加舒適，城市治理更加高效。相信在座的各位記者朋友對此也感同身受。集安全感、舒適感和未來感於一體的“中國遊”體驗，讓中國城市收穫了海外的口碑。林劍進一步介紹，“同時我們也同各國，特別是全球南方國家分享城市治理和發展經驗，開展住房發展、綠色低碳、智慧城市等領域的交流。中國還積極參與了聯合國人居領域的合作，透過舉辦世界城市系列活動，設立全球可持續發展城市獎，支援聯合國人居署推進新城市議程，得到國際社會的廣泛認可。中方也攜手各國持續推進落實全球發展倡議，深化城市領域的交流合作，為落實聯合國2030年可持續發展議程注入更多動力。”（澎湃新聞）

Iron Ore Weakens to Near 2-Month Low — Iron ore futures fell below CNY 760 per ton, sinking to a near two-month low after data showed China’s iron ore imports dropped nearly 6% in May from the previous month, defying expectations for an increase amid improved steel margins and higher shipments from major producers. China imported 97.71 million tons of the key steelmaking ingredient last month, down from 103.9 million tons in April and below analysts’ forecasts of 104 million to 110 million tons. Analysts attributed the decline to cautious purchasing by steelmakers, who have limited buying to immediate needs ahead of a seasonally weaker demand period. Demand from China’s steel sector has also softened earlier than usual this year, as persistent rainfall and the early arrival of summer heat have slowed construction activity.

【Tabbit瀏覽器V1.0釋出：標準版永久免費 專業版9.9元/周】Tabbit瀏覽器V1.0釋出會舉行，Tabbit 負責人劉炯發表演講。談及“為何重做瀏覽器”的問題，劉炯稱，瀏覽器雖然產品形態落後，但在工作中作用愈發重要，因此更需要變革。他還提到，瀏覽器是意圖誕生的地方，更是人與AI的共享環境，人和AI不應該隔著對話方塊聊天。今年3月初，美團旗下光年之外團隊宣佈，其全新產品Tabbit AI瀏覽器進入公測。劉炯表示，本週將會開始向使用者推送Tabbit瀏覽器1.0版本 ，目前Tabbit瀏覽器已支援超10個頂尖大模型，可實現多模型的呼叫。據介紹，Tabbit瀏覽器1.0版本分為標準版和專業版。在會上，劉炯說道，承諾標準版永久免費，專業版收費9.9元/周，國際版定價另行通知。（新浪科技）

【China defense ministry says Japan's hype over lawful carrier operations will fail】China's defense ministry said on June 9 the aircraft carrier Liaoning is conducting planned training in West Pacific waters to improve carrier battle group combat capability and is not directed at any specific country. Spokesman Zhang Xiaogang said Japan has repeatedly shadowed the formation and publicly disclosed vessel counts, operating areas and carrier sortie numbers; Chinese ships handled the monitoring in accordance with law and regulations. He accused Japan of sensationalizing China's lawful actions to stoke tension and said such efforts will not succeed.

【國防部：日方炒作中方正當行動不可能得逞】6月9日下午，國防部新聞發言人張曉剛大校就近期涉軍問題釋出訊息。記者：據報道，近期日方多次跟監遼寧艦航母編隊在西太平洋訓練，日本防衛省連續公佈編隊艦艇數量、所在海域、艦載機起降架次等情況。日防衛大臣表示將密切關注中方航母編隊動向，繼續進行警戒監視。請問對此有何評論？張曉剛：目前，遼寧艦航母編隊正按計劃在西太平洋相關海域開展訓練。此次行動不針對任何特定國家和目標，旨在透過遠海訓練提升航母編隊戰鬥力。其間，日方多次進行跟蹤監視，中方艦艇編隊依法依規予以處置。日方對中方正當行動煽宣炒作，妄圖製造緊張、誤導輿論，明眼人看得一清二楚，這是不可能得逞的。

Austria Trade Deficit Narrows in March — Austria’s trade deficit narrowed to EUR 563.3 billion in March 2026 from a EUR 892 billion deficit in the same month of the previous year. Exports increased 9.5% year-on-year to EUR 18.17 billion. The growth was led by increased sales of machinery and vehicles, processed goods, chemical products and other manufactured goods. Intra-EU and extra-EU exports surged by 8.2% and 2.5%, respectively. In addition, imports increased 7.1% to EUR 18.73 billion, mainly due to stronger purchases of machinery and vehicles and processed goods. Intra-EU imports rose by 5.8%, while imports from non-EU countries increased by 9.7%.

【訊息人士：印度研究收購俄羅斯焦煤資產與進口鎳的可能性】據印度訊息人士透露，印度國有鋼鐵管理局和NMDC公司正在研究收購俄羅斯焦煤資產的可能性。印度正尋求確保關鍵原材料的供應安全。三位熟悉情況的訊息人士表示，印度上個月派了一個代表團前往俄羅斯，與俄方政府及企業高管進行了初步磋商。其中一位訊息人士稱，鋼鐵管理局和NMDC都在探索原材料採購渠道，正在與俄方接觸。他還補充說，鋼鐵管理局已經成立了一個內部小組來研究此事。兩位印度訊息人士和一位俄羅斯訊息人士表示，印度還希望增加從俄羅斯進口鎳。兩位印度訊息人士稱，雙方已於4月在新德里進行了初步會談。

【Sources: India studies purchase of Russian coking coal assets and increased nickel imports】State-owned Steel Authority of India (SAIL) and NMDC Ltd are studying acquisitions of Russian coking coal assets, sources said. A delegation visited Russia last month for preliminary talks with Russian government officials and corporate executives. SAIL has formed an internal team to evaluate the opportunity. India is also seeking to increase nickel imports from Russia; preliminary talks on nickel were held in New Delhi in April, sources added.

【Shenzhen Shuibei merchants report weak retail gold demand as prices fall】Merchants at Shenzhen's Shuibei gold market said that when prices were rising they could sell about 2 kg a day, generating roughly 2 million yuan in daily sales. With gold prices falling recently, many consumers are "looking but not buying", and a number of peers have sold inventories and exited the business.

【騰訊回應微信開放AI生態接入能力：為給使用者提供更智慧的互動體驗】昨日，微信釋出《關於開發者接入微信AI生態的指引》，面向開發者提供接入微信AI（人工智慧）生態的能力。據悉，平臺提供自動模式與開發模式兩種接入選項，以滿足不同規模團隊的開發需求。其中，自動模式需授權平臺提審時讀取小程式原始碼，無需投入額外開發。平臺將分析開發者的小程式頁面，讓微信AI能直接操作；開發模式中，開發者可基於小程式業務特性，自主個性化開發。透過平臺評測與稽核後，可被微信Al呼叫。微信釋出後，京東、美團、滴滴、攜程、同程、得物和肯德基等都宣佈作為首批內測團隊接入微信AI。對此，騰訊回應表示，“為給使用者提供更智慧的互動體驗，微信開放平臺在充分尊重開發者權益和自主選擇的基礎上，面向開發者提供了便捷接入微信AI生態的能力。目前該能力正在內測階段，請開發者留意小程式後臺訊息提醒。”（新浪科技）

【禮來：口服小分子Orforglipron三項3期研究展現優效控糖與減重效果】6月8日，禮來公司公佈了ACHIEVE系列三項3期臨床研究的詳細結果。該系列研究評估了orforglipron在2型糖尿病成人患者中的有效性與安全性。在ACHIEVE-3研究中，orforglipron 17.2mg組較口服司美格魯肽14mg組實現更優的糖化血紅蛋白（A1C）和體重降低效果，其中A1C相對降幅高57.1%，相對體重降幅高73.6%。禮來計劃於第二季度末向美國食品藥品監督管理局（FDA）遞交orforglipron用於治療2型糖尿病的上市申請。

【中蒙“草原夥伴-2026”陸軍聯訓提升聯合遂行任務能力】6月9日下午，國防部新聞發言人張曉剛大校就近期涉軍問題釋出訊息。 記者：據報道，中蒙“草原夥伴-2026”陸軍聯合訓練圓滿結束。請進一步介紹有關情況。 張曉剛：5月30日至6月6日，中蒙“草原夥伴-2026”陸軍聯訓在內蒙古某聯合訓練基地成功舉行，雙方以聯合打擊非法武裝組織行動為課題，圍繞聯合指揮、協同打擊等課目開展實戰化訓練。鐵甲突擊，智戰草原，無人化智慧化裝備成體系運用是亮點之一。其中，有人無人協同進攻戰鬥訓練採取實兵對抗、鐳射交戰等方式組織實施，涵蓋無人偵察打擊、有人無人協同衝擊、克服和透過障礙、塹壕清剿等內容。這是中蒙兩國陸軍第2次舉行該系列聯訓，雙方透過交流戰法訓法，進一步深化兩軍交流合作，提升共同應對安全風險、聯合遂行任務的能力。

【韓國暫時收緊對銀行外匯頭寸的監控】韓國金融監督院(FSS)在一份宣告中表示，將暫時加強對主要銀行外匯頭寸的監控，把審查週期從每月縮短到每週，甚至可能每天。FSS週二與韓國主要銀行及外資銀行在當地的分行舉行會議，評估當前外匯市場狀況，並商討如何應對外匯市場波動加劇。敦促銀行避免對美元存款進行過度營銷。尋求銀行配合，確保離岸NDF交易不會加劇國內外匯市場波動，或造成過度的單邊持倉。

Rupiah Finds Support After Surprise BI Rate Hike — The rupiah firmed to around IDR 18,100 per U.S. dollar on Tuesday afternoon, rebounding after an intraday low of 18,234. The recovery came after Bank Indonesia unexpectedly raised its key interest rates in an off-schedule meeting today, aiming to support the currency amid global market volatility linked to tensions in the Middle East and to keep inflation within its target range. The central bank lifted its benchmark rate by 25bp to 5.5%, following a 50bp lift at its regular policy meeting in May. Officials signaled that stabilising the rupiah was a key objective, as the currency remains among Asia’s worst performers this year. The currency had been pressured by heavy selling in Indonesian assets, eroding investor confidence amid domestic policy concerns and persistent external risks. Sentiment also improved as the dollar index eased from a nine-week high after Iran and Israel agreed to halt attacks, tempering geopolitical tensions and boosting risk appetite across global markets.

【Yue Mon: Hong Kong Q1 GDP +5.9% YoY, inflows signal investor confidence】Hong Kong Monetary Authority chief Yue Mon said Q1 GDP rose 5.9% YoY, the fastest quarterly pace in nearly five years. He attributed growth to exports, consumption and investment, with exports especially strong: about 70% of export categories are AI and high-end electronics, and sustained global tech demand should continue to support trade and related industries. Domestic demand is recovering—housing has rebounded roughly 10% from the trough, boosting consumption via a wealth effect—and corporate investment is gradually returning, with overall investment now positive. Yue said the trend of global investors diversifying away from single-market risk should continue, and Hong Kong’s institutional, geographic and market advantages will keep attracting capital inflows.

【餘偉文：香港經濟增速創新高，資金流入印證投資者信心】面對21世紀經濟報道記者提出的“香港一季度經濟復甦是否具有可持續性”這一問題。餘偉文坦言，香港今年一季度GDP同比增長5.9%，創下近五年季度增速新高，經濟復甦的內在動力十分紮實。他分析，本輪高增長由出口、消費、投資三大引擎共同拉動。出口端表現尤為突出，香港出口中約七成品類為AI及高階電子產品，當前全球科技產品需求旺盛，這一增長趨勢具備延續性，將持續為香港貿易、相關產業帶來支撐。內需市場同步回暖，樓市自谷底反彈約10%，財富效應進一步啟用居民消費意願；企業投資熱情也逐步回升，整體投資資料實現正向增長，經濟內生活力持續釋放。餘偉文表示，全球投資者規避單一市場風險、推進資產多元化的趨勢不會逆轉，香港作為佈局中國市場的核心樞紐，兼具制度、區位、市場三重優勢，未來仍將持續吸引全球資金流入。（21財經）

【因轉向助力線束存在起火隱患，克萊斯勒在美召回超107萬輛Jeep越野車】美國國家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）6月9日釋出安全警告，克萊斯勒正申請召回部分2021至2025款的Jeep Wrangler和Jeep Gladiator汽車，本次召回潛在受影響的車輛總數高達1,076,999輛。報告指出，本次召回的核心原因為相關車輛的電動液壓動力轉向泵線束可能發生過熱，從而引發車輛起火隱患，即使車輛處於熄火停放狀態，相關線束仍有可能因過熱引發火災。

【高盛：雲端與資料中心子行業仍為下半年最看好領域】高盛發表報告指，雲端與資料中心子行業仍然是該行在2026年下半年最看好的領域，主要推薦標的仍為：阿里巴巴(列入亞太區確信買入名單)、萬國資料、世紀互聯及金山雲。儘管第一季度現有產能擴張及進駐速度低於預期，該行預期雲端服務漲價/持續的Token擴張將推動雲端增長與利潤率擴張，而超大規模雲端營運商的資本支出亦會提升。該行現估計位元組跳動、百度、阿里及騰訊(BBAT)在2026年全年資本支出為1000億美元，下半年比重較高，將支撐資料中心在下半年加速的季度增長。同時，季度至今的宏觀經濟/消費趨勢疲軟，使該行將遊戲與娛樂的投資優先順序提升至第二位，網易為新推薦標的，與騰訊並列。該行將電子商務與出行移動下調至第三位，重申京東為2026下半年的主要推薦標的，預期下半年營收與利潤將實現按年復甦。在AI模型公司方面，該行特別點出MiniMax，因其年度經常性收入(ARR)具備上行潛力，風險回報傾向上行。

Japan Machine Tool Orders Ease in May — Japan’s machine tool orders grew by 37.4% year-on-year to JPY 176,883 million in May 2026, slowing from an over four-year high of 45.1% in the previous month. Gains were softer in both foreign and domestic demand. Foreign orders increased 37.7%, following a 45.7% jump in April, while domestic orders climbed by 36.4% after a 45.7% advance previously. On a monthly basis, machine tool orders continued to decline, falling 6.4% in May after a 2.3% drop in the preceding period. For the January–May period, total machine tool orders increased by 32.2% compared to the same period a year ago to JPY 851,593 million, driven by a 37.9% rise in overseas demand and a 17.6% increase in domestic orders.

Saudi Arabia GDP Growth Softest in Almost Two Years — Saudi Arabia’s economy expanded 3.0% year-on-year in the first quarter of 2026, revised higher from a preliminary estimate of 2.8% but slowing from 5.0% growth in the previous period. This marks the softest economic expansion since the second quarter of 2024, as growth in oil activities slowed to 2.9% from 10.8% in Q4, pressured by ongoing US–Iran tensions that disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint for about 20% of global oil and LNG trade. Non-oil activities also rose at a softer pace of 2.9%, down from 4.6% in the prior quarter. Meanwhile, government activities rebounded by 1.5%, following a 1.2% contraction in the previous period. On a quarterly basis, the economy contracted by 1.2% in Q1, primarily due to a 6.8% decline in oil activities, which was partially offset by increases of 1.4% in government activities and 0.3% in non-oil activities.

Hungary Inflation Slows in May — The annual inflation rate in Hungary eased to 1.8% in May 2026 from a three-month high of 2.1% in the previous month, falling short of market expectations of 2.3%. The slowdown was due largely by softer price increases in food (0.5% vs 1.5% in April), alcoholic beverages, tobacco products (3.3% vs 4.1%), and consumer durables (2.4% vs 2.7%). At the same time, costs for household energy declined by 2% after falling 0.4% in the prior month. On the other hand, inflation accelerated for clothing (1.1% vs 0.8%), other goods, including other items and fuels (0.4% vs 0.1%), and services (4.3% vs 4%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices were unchanged in May, after rising 0.4% in the preceding period. Meanwhile, the annual core inflation rate, which excludes volatile items such as food and energy, slowed to 2% from 2.2% in April, below market forecasts of 2.3%.

【王傳福回應股價被低估：要對比亞迪有信心、做價值投資，當前瓶頸是二代刀片電池產能】比亞迪今日舉行2025年度股東會，比亞迪董事長王傳福等高管出席。被問及當前比亞迪股價和市值被低估一事，王傳福表示，感謝股東支援，完全理解大家對股價的關切，要對比亞迪有信心，要做價值投資。他透露， 比亞迪當前銷量的最大瓶頸是二代刀片電池產能爬坡，目前正在夜以繼日攻堅。2026年銷量取決於電池產量，2027年電池產能大規模釋放後，國內、國際市場將同時發力，預計會有很大提升。（新浪科技）

【China holds meeting of central safety-assessment inspection team leaders】Ahead of planned Q2–Q3 overt and covert inspections, Beijing hosted a June 8 meeting of leaders from the central safety-production assessment and inspection teams. Teams were ordered to conduct on-site, in-depth checks and to refer identified major accident hazards in key sectors — mining, chemicals, fireworks, construction, firefighting, industry and trade, and special equipment — to provincial party and government authorities. Provinces are to be urged to verify rectifications, trace responsibility and impose strict sanctions. The meeting also mandated special inspections of regulatory enforcement, combining inspection with remediation, and strict action against illegal safety practices, falsification and corruption in the safety sector.

【中央安全生產考核巡查組組長工作座談會召開】在即將開展第二、三季度明查暗訪之際，6月8日，中央安全生產考核巡查組組長工作座談會在京召開。會議強調，中央安全生產考核巡查組開展明查暗訪期間，要直奔現場、深挖細查，對發現的礦山、化工、煙花爆竹、建築施工、消防、工貿、特種裝置等重點行業領域典型重大事故隱患，移交省級黨委和政府，督促地方組織核查整改、倒查責任、嚴肅處理。要開展監管執法問題專項檢查，堅持查治一體，嚴肅查處安全生產非法違法和弄虛作假等行為，以及安全生產領域風腐等突出問題。（應急管理部）

【氫能關注度再升溫，國內氫能相關專利已超8600件，去年申請超1300件】氫能作為國家明確的未來產業，2026年熱度持續攀升，政策與產業落地同步提速。截至2026年3月底，全國建成在建可再生能源制氫產能規模超過100萬噸/年，其中，建成投運超25萬噸/年，較2024年底增長超1倍。政策端，3月三部門啟動氫能綜合應用試點，目標2030年終端用氫價降至25元/千克以下。FCVC2026氫能大會（6月10日—12日）將至，行業關注度再升溫。綠氫規模化、重卡等多場景滲透加速，氫能正從示範走向規模化發展關鍵期。企查查資料顯示，我國現有超8600件氫能相關專利，2025年全年，我國累計申請1314件氫能相關專利，創近五年氫能相關專利申請量新高。截至6月9日，2026年我國已申請204件氫能相關專利。企業存量方面，截至2026年6月9日，我國現存3986家氫能相關企業。區域分佈上，華東地區最多，佔比34.0%，其次是華北地區，佔比20.5%。

【特朗普在過去數月內至少37次公開宣稱美伊雙方“即將達成協議”】自美國總統唐納德·特朗普宣佈美伊停火以來，時間已過去兩個多月。儘管特朗普在過去數月內至少37次公開宣稱美伊雙方“即將達成協議”，但截至目前，雙邊談判仍未取得實質性進展，協議依舊未能簽署。分析人士指出，儘管美伊停火已持續兩月有餘，但由於雙方缺乏戰略互信，加之中東地區局勢錯綜複雜，雙邊關係走向仍存在高度不確定性。特朗普頻繁宣稱“接近達成協議”，或意在安撫國際金融市場並提振國內政治支援率，實際談判程序並未取得根本性突破。
【桃李麵包旗下海南桃李麵包公司增資至1.3億 增幅約86%】天眼查App顯示，近日，海南桃李麵包有限公司發生工商變更，註冊資本由7000萬人民幣增至1.3億人民幣，增幅約86%。該公司成立於2019年3月，法定代表人為朱迪，經營範圍包括食品生產、糧食加工食品生產、食品經營等，由桃李麵包（603866）全資持股。

Bank Indonesia Delivers Surprise Rate Hike to Support Rupiah — Bank Indonesia unexpectedly raised its key interest rates in an off-schedule meeting on Tuesday as mounting external pressures continued to weigh on the rupiah. The central bank increased its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%, while also lifting the overnight deposit facility rate to 4.50% and the lending facility rate to 6.25%. In addition to the rate hike, BI introduced measures aimed at supporting the currency, including incentives to attract foreign investment. The central bank said the policy package is intended to stabilize the rupiah amid heightened global market volatility linked to tensions in the Middle East and to keep inflation within its target range. According to BI's communication department, the decision reflects efforts to safeguard financial stability while maintaining confidence in Indonesia's economy against a backdrop of rising external risks.

【機構：透過與英偉達的AI合作，Naver的價值可能增長兩倍】Kyobo Securities的Kim Dong-woo表示，透過與英偉達合作運營吉瓦級全球人工智慧資料中心，Naver的企業價值可能增長兩倍。該分析師預計，Naver的估值將從目前的2.3萬億韓元升至6.9萬億韓元，這部分得益於AI工廠收入預計將在2027年達到4,750億韓元，在2028年達到2.5萬億韓元。他對Naver的計劃持樂觀態度，即作為英偉達主導的吉瓦級倡議的一部分，到2027年上半年將其AI資料中心算力擴大至55兆瓦，到2027年底擴大至100兆瓦，並在2028年擴大至200兆瓦。

【韓國準備開展現場外匯檢查以抑制韓元投機交易】韓國財政部表示，將打擊投機性外匯交易，監管機構計劃進行現場檢查，並對涉嫌擾亂市場的活動展開調查。韓國財政部負責國際事務的副部長Moon Ji-sung在一份宣告中表示，當局將重點打擊旨在扭曲市場的交易，並於本週進行現場檢查，調查參與者是否參與投機性交易。宣告還補充說，政府認為當前形勢嚴峻，正與其他機構協調密切關注市場趨勢和主要訂單流向。該計劃是在財政部與外匯市場參與者和專家舉行會議後製定的，此前在週末進行了緊急市場評估。

【華海清科獲得國內首臺全自動板級CMP量產裝備訂單】據華海清科訊息，近日，華海清科自主研發的國內首臺510*515mm尺寸全自動板級CMP量產裝備Master-P510APEX成功獲得先進封裝領域重要客戶訂單，將按計劃進入客戶端產線投入量產應用。公司表示，該裝備將成為國內首臺進入產線的國產全自動板級CMP裝備，為我國先進封裝乃至半導體產業自主可控補齊關鍵一環。此次突破也是華海清科CMP裝備技術從晶圓級向板級延伸的重要里程碑。

【商務部：支援中亞各國擴大對華出口非資源商品和農產品】6月9日，第九屆中國—亞歐博覽會新聞釋出會在北京舉辦。商務部歐亞司副司長張棟介紹了接下來商務部將整體推進中國—中亞經貿合作的措施。一是加強發展戰略對接。我們將推動共建“一帶一路”倡議同中亞各國發展戰略對接，落實好與中亞各國簽署的政府間經貿合作規劃，探討建立貿易投資自由化便利化制度性安排，推動構建更緊密的經濟夥伴關係。二是推動貿易提質增效。我們將繼續鞏固能源、礦產等大宗商品貿易，支援中亞各國積極參加“共享大市場 出口中國”系列活動，擴大對華出口非資源商品和農產品。拓展服務貿易、數字貿易、跨境電商等新業態，加快中國—中亞貿易暢通合作平臺建設，打造中國—中亞貿易新的增長點。三是持續深化產供鏈合作。我們將加強綠色礦產合作，推進“探產供儲銷”全產業鏈協同。深化新能源、數字經濟、人工智慧、裝備製造、現代農業等領域合作，促進貿易投資一體化發展。我們將用好中國—中亞股權投資合作基金等投融資工具，助力中亞國家產業升級，共同打造可持續、有韌性、更暢通的區域產供鏈體系。（澎湃新聞）

Lithuania Trade Gap Biggest in 9 Months — Lithuania posted a trade deficit of EUR 606.9 million in April 2026, widening from EUR 567.7 million in the same month last year. This marked the biggest trade shortfall since July last year, as exports rose more than imports. Exports climbed by 18.2% year-on-year to an over three-year high of EUR 3,613.9 million, driven largely by higher sales of mineral fuels, mineral oils and products of their distillation (88.7%), machinery and mechanical appliances (38.3%), and plastics and articles thereof (23.6%). Meanwhile, imports grew at a slightly softer 16.4% but to also a more than three-year high of EUR 4,220.8 million, due to increased purchases of mineral fuels, mineral oils and products of their distillation (49.8%), and electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof (46.5%). In the January–April period, the country’s trade deficit narrowed to EUR 1,958 million from EUR 2,219.6 million in the same period a year ago, as exports (3.4%) rose faster than imports (1.1%).

【German industrial output rises for first time since outbreak of war in Iran】DESTATIS said on Tuesday Germany's industrial production rose 0.4% MoM in April, the first increase since the outbreak of the war in Iran, largely driven by construction. March was revised to a -0.1% decline from a preliminary -0.7%. April exports and imports unexpectedly rose. The data contrast with earlier weak prints: April factory orders fell more than expected on Monday, with notable declines in autos and electrical equipment. The production uptick offers limited relief to Europe’s largest economy amid surging energy prices.

Danish Manufacturing Output Falls in April — Denmark’s manufacturing production fell 1.1% month-on-month in April 2026, following a downwardly revised 8.3% growth in the previous month. Output declined in food, beverages, and tobacco (-2.7% vs 5.5% in March), wood and paper products (-2.1% vs 2.1%), pharmaceutical products (-2.5% vs 15%), electronics (-15.8% vs 37%), rubber, plastic, glass, and concrete products (-1% vs 15.5%), and transportation (-2.2% vs 19.5%). At the same time, activity moderated for textile, clothing, and leather products (2.4% vs 9.5%). Meanwhile, production increased for metal and metal products (5% vs 0.4%), while production recovered for petroleum and chemical products (1.3% vs -0.9%). On a seasonally adjusted annual basis, manufacturing activity jumped 13% in April, easing from a revised 21.1% gain in the preceding period.

【英偉達Blackwell“一芯難求”？ 機構：從來未見如此供應緊張局面】韋德布什證券（Wedbush Securities）最新報告稱，英偉達的Grace Blackwell系統（包括GB300和B300）的需求還在持續高漲，因為一些客戶表示這些產品越來越難採購。“自Ampere/Hopper以來，我們不記得英偉達加速器週期後期出現過如此嚴重的供應緊張狀況，這一結果表明需求增長速度比之前預期的要快。”他們寫道。韋德布什還補充稱，儘管供應限制，尤其是記憶體方面的供應限制，仍然是造成供貨問題的主要原因，但就目前的供應鏈定位而言，英偉達“在整個技術生態系統中處於最佳地位”。

【首創期貨：保供政策出臺，焦煤期價盤中跌停】供應方面，陝西省發改委釋出關於做好迎峰度夏能源保供工作的通知，督促煤炭企業在安全前提下依法合規釋放先進產能。該訊息引發多頭獲利了結，焦煤主力09合約兩個交易日累計減倉超11萬手。近日煤礦復產進度有所加快，截至6月8日，復產煤礦共計70座，產能8515萬噸，仍在停產煤礦共計65座，產能共計6975萬噸。進口方面蒙煤通關車輛維持高位。保供政策疊加市場情緒擾動下，預計短期焦煤期價震盪調整為主，關注國內煤礦開工及鐵水產量變動情況。（首創期貨）

【伊朗和以色列停止襲擊後，美元下跌】伊朗和以色列週一暫停襲擊後，隨著油價回落以及對避險資產的需求減弱，美元下跌。伊朗和以色列表示將停止交火，但承諾如果戰鬥再次爆發將進行報復。美國總統特朗普介入了衝突，稱伊朗和以色列必須停止射擊，並宣佈兩國都希望立即停火。德意志銀行分析師在一份報告中表示：“感覺至少在目前，週末爆發的敵對行動已經停止，和平談判仍有繼續的途徑。”DXY美元指數下跌0.2%，至99.838。

ASX 200 Pares Losses at Finish — The ASX 200 edged down 21 points or 0.2% to end at 8,604 on Tuesday, down for the third session after fresh data showed Australia's consumer confidence fell in June following May's rise and marking its fourth decline this year amid lingering cost-of-living pressures. Separately, business sentiment in May improved but remained firmly negative, due to concerns over the impact of elevated borrowing costs. Still, local markets trimmed early declines after solid May trade data in top trading partner China, as exports hit a record high while imports accelerated. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of Australia will hold a policy meeting next week, with traders expecting a pause following three rate hikes since January. In the U.S., stock futures strengthened, following a rebound in chip stocks on Wall Street Monday. Among today's decliners were Lynas Rare Earths(-4.5%), Evolution Mining (-4.2%), Fortescue (-3.5%), and heavyweight BHP Group (-1.7%). Two of four big banks fell between 0.5% and 1%.

Japan 10Y Yield Falls as Oil Prices Retreat — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield fell to around 2.67% on Tuesday, pulling back from a two-week high as oil prices declined after Iran and Israel agreed to halt attacks against each other, boosting hopes that peace negotiations could move forward. The easing in oil prices helped reduce concerns about energy-driven inflation and the need for higher interest rates. Even so, the Bank of Japan is still widely expected to raise interest rates later this month as policymakers contend with persistent inflationary pressures linked to elevated energy costs. Reports also indicated that the BOJ will review its bond tapering plan and is likely to further reduce its monthly bond purchases. Meanwhile, investors are awaiting Wednesday’s auction of 30-year Japanese government bonds to gauge demand in a high-yield environment.

German Industrial Output Rebounds in April — Germany’s industrial production rose 0.4% month-on-month in April 2026, rebounding from a revised 0.1% decline in March and matching market expectations. This marked the first increase since the war began in late February, largely driven by stronger activity in construction (+2.4%), the chemical industry (+2.1%), and fabricated metal products, except machinery and equipment (+1.6%). In contrast, output in the automotive industry fell sharply by 4.7%. Excluding energy and construction, industrial production was unchanged from the previous month, as gains in intermediate goods (+1.4%) and consumer goods (+1.9%) offset a decline in capital goods production (-1.5%). Outside industry, energy production edged up 0.2%. On a less volatile three-month basis, industrial output declined 0.5% in the February–April period compared with the previous three months. On an annual basis, industrial production fell 0.5%, following a 3.4% drop in March.

Romania Trade Deficit Narrows in April — Romania’s trade deficit narrowed to EUR 3.075 billion in April 2026 from EUR 3.137 billion in the corresponding month a year earlier. Exports rose 4.3% year-on-year to EUR 8.203 billion, supported by stronger shipments to both EU (2.8%) and non-EU markets (8.1%). Meanwhile, imports increased 2.5% to EUR 11.279 billion, driven by higher purchases from the EU (2.1%) and non-EU countries (3.4%). In the first four months of 2026, the trade deficit stood at EUR 10.815 billion, narrowing from EUR 11.633 billion in the same period last year. Over this period, exports rose 1.9% to EUR 32.017 billion, supported by higher sales of transport equipment (1.9%), manufactured goods (4.7%), food and live animals (6.9%), and chemicals and related products (4.6%). In contrast, imports fell 0.5% to EUR 42.833 billion, weighed by lower purchases of manufactured goods (-1.9%), manufactured articles (-3.3%), chemicals and related products (-1.7%), and mineral fuels, lubricants and related (-2.1%).

German Trade Surplus Smallest in 5 Months — Germany’s trade surplus narrowed to €14.5 billion in April 2026 from an upwardly revised €14.7 billion in March, falling short of market expectations of €15.0 billion. It was the smallest trade surplus since November, as imports grew faster than exports. Exports unexpectedly increased by 0.9% month-on-month to a near 3½-year high of €136.6 billion, accelerating from a downwardly revised 0.3% gain in March and easily beating expectations of a 0.3% decline. Shipments to EU member states increased 1.0%, while those to third countries rose 0.7%. Meanwhile, imports climbed 1.2% month-on-month to €122.1 billion, the highest level since November 2022, though easing from a downwardly revised 4.5% increase in March.

Danish Trade Surplus Widens in April — Denmark’s seasonally adjusted trade surplus widened to DKK 32.8 billion in April 2026 from a downwardly revised DKK 31.4 billion in March. Denmark Current Account Surplus Highest in 7 Months — Denmark’s seasonally adjusted current account surplus edged up to DKK 37.5 billion in April 2026 from a downwardly revised DKK 37.4 billion in the previous month. Meanwhile, the goods account surplus narrowed to DKK 30.6 billion from DKK 30.9 billion, weighed down by declines in both exports and imports of 1.5% and 1.7%, respectively. Norway Producer Inflation Nears 4-Year High — Producer prices in Norway climbed 24.0% year-on-year in May 2026, accelerating from 22.7% in the previous month. It marked the third consecutive month of increases and the highest reading since September 2022, driven by stronger price growth in manufacturing (9.4% vs 7.4% in April), particularly for refined petroleum products (64.7% vs 42.3%) and basic metals (14.1% vs 10.4%). Producer inflation was also supported by faster growth in prices for electricity, gas and steam (58.5% vs 46.4%) and energy goods (41.2% vs 39.0%). Meanwhile, costs for the extraction of oil and natural gas eased slightly (35.1% vs 35.5%). Excluding energy goods, producer prices increased 5.7%, from 4.5% in April. On a monthly basis, producer prices fell 1.8% in May, following a 0.5% fall in the previous month.

Lithuania Producer Inflation Eases in May — Producer prices in Lithuania rose 12.8% year-on-year in May 2026, slowing from a downwardly revised over three-year high of 13.1% in the previous month. This marked the third consecutive month of producer price increases, albeit at a softer pace. Cost growth moderated in manufacturing (13.2% vs 13.7% in April), particularly in coke and refined petroleum products, which eased to 73.2% after a 77.0% surge. Additionally, inflation decelerated for water supply, sewerage, waste management and remediation activities (3.3% vs 5.1%). Meanwhile, prices accelerated in mining and quarrying (5.5% vs 0.9%) and electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply (8.0% vs 4.1%). On a monthly basis, producer prices fell 0.8%, reversing a 2.5% increase in the previous period.

Finnish Trade Gap Slightly Narrows in April — Finland recorded a trade deficit of EUR 0.33 billion in April 2026, slightly narrowing from EUR 0.34 billion in the corresponding month of the previous year, preliminary estimates showed. Exports grew by 19.8% year-on-year to EUR 7.19 billion, driven by higher sales to both EU (+7.6%) and non-EU countries (+39.2%). Shipments to Sweden (+20.6%), the US (+79.6%), China (++21.5%), Norway (+34.9%), and Estonia (+23%). Meanwhile, imports rose at a slightly softer 18.6% to EUR 7.51 billion. It should be noted that imports from EU countries are now compiled using a new methodology starting January 2026, so only total values are comparable with those of 2025. Finnish Customs will not publish other annual change data for imports in 2026. Considering the first four months of 2026, the country’s trade deficit expanded to EUR 1.39 billion from EUR 1.02 billion in the same period a year ago.

Germany Imports Hit Highest Since November 2022 — Germany’s imports rose 1.2% month-on-month to €122.1 billion in April 2026, the highest level since November 2022. However, growth slowed markedly from a downwardly revised 4.5% increase in the previous month. Imports from EU member states edged up 0.4%, supported by a 2.2% rise in purchases from euro-area countries, which offset a 3.4% decline in imports from non-euro-area EU members. Meanwhile, imports from non-EU countries increased 2.0%, driven by higher shipments from the U.S. (7.6%) and China (0.2%), despite a 4.7% drop in purchases from the United Kingdom. On an annual basis, total imports were 6.3% higher than a year earlier, though the pace eased from a 10.4% increase in March. For the January–April period, Germany’s imports rose 2.8% from the same period in 2025 to €468.4 billion, reflecting resilient domestic demand despite ongoing economic uncertainty.

German Exports Hit Near 3-1/2-Year High — Germany’s exports unexpectedly grew by 0.9% month-on-month to a near 3½-year high of €136.6 billion in April 2026, accelerating from a downwardly revised 0.3% rise in March and beating market expectations of a 0.3% decline. Shipments to EU member states increased 1.0%, with exports to the Eurozone edging up 0.1% and those to non-Eurozone countries rising 3.0%. Exports to third countries also climbed 0.7%, supported by a 1.8% increase in shipments to the US, Germany’s largest export market.

【日本央行前官員預計6月加息之後可能還將於10月再次升息】前日本央行執行理事Hideo Hayakawa稱，在下週備受期待的加息之後，央行可能最早在10月再次加息，以在抗通脹方面保持先發優勢。他週二接受採訪時表示，在6月行動之後，“下次加息最早可能在10月”，“日本央行目前已經有些落後於形勢，所以他們需要抓緊趕上。”日本央行下週將公佈利率決定，市場普遍預計將加息0.25個百分點，這將是自12月以來的首次調整。市場普遍認為日本央行對通脹壓力的反應過於遲緩。下週會議的焦點將是任何可能加速加息的訊號。Hayakawa指出，近期日本債券市場的劇烈波動可能已成為日本央行不容忽視的問題。5月18日，日本10年期國債收益率觸及2.8%，創1996年以來的最高水平，這一走勢促使Hayakawa確信央行6月加息勢在必行。“近期債券收益率的快速上升，部分反映了市場對日本央行加息能力的擔憂，”Hayakawa表示。“日本央行肯定認為他們必須採取行動。”

【香港電影人黃百鳴被判入獄5個月】據多家港媒報道，現年80歲的天馬影視（現稱傳遞娛樂）前主席、香港電影人黃百鳴涉及於2017年天馬影視公佈賣盤前慫使胞妹購入公司股票一事，早前被裁定內幕交易罪罪成，6月9日於香港西九龍裁判法院判決。西九龍裁判處裁判官高偉雄宣佈，黃百鳴涉內幕交易罪罪成，裁定黃百鳴監禁5個月，並裁定罰款99720港元，以及涉及香港證監會的調查費用37.4萬港元。高偉雄指出，儘管黃百鳴對香港電影業奉獻一生，且胞妹獲得的實際利益不算大，但其作為天馬影視的股東，其舉動會令公眾對香港證券市場的信心造成影響，黃百鳴因本案聲譽受損及影響身心健康不能成為減刑理由。黃百鳴申請保釋等候上訴獲批。

【UN issues third World Ocean Assessment, urges stronger cooperation to protect marine ecosystems】The United Nations’ third World Ocean Assessment says human and natural factors are increasingly stressing marine ecosystems and calls for translating scientific findings into concrete action and greater international cooperation to protect oceans. The report finds global ocean warming and sea level rise are accelerating: about 16% of the total increase in ocean heat content since 1955 occurred after 2018, with the Atlantic, southern Indian Ocean and South Pacific warming most markedly. Mean sea level rise accelerated from under 2 mm/yr before 2015 to 4.3 mm/yr in 2023, with tropical regions rising faster due to thermal expansion.

【Sources: BOJ weighing pause in JGB taper from next fiscal year, may lift short-term rate to 1% next week】Sources say the Bank of Japan is considering keeping its current JGB purchase volume unchanged from the next fiscal year rather than continuing scheduled reductions. Policy board views are split between members prioritizing market calm and those pushing steady tapering to shrink the central bank's balance sheet. At the June meeting the BOJ will review the current taper program (running through next March) and set policy for FY2027 and beyond. Four people familiar with the bank's thinking said, given progress in shrinking its balance sheet and upcoming bond maturities that will lower holdings, internal sentiment has shifted toward pausing further tapering. The BOJ could abandon its practice of an annual taper plan and adopt an open-ended framework committing to monthly purchases of JPY 2.1 tln. Markets expect the BOJ to raise the short-term policy rate from 0.75% to 1% at next week’s meeting.

Estonia Trade Deficit Widens in April — Estonia’s trade deficit widened to EUR 365 million in April 2026 from EUR 347 million in the same month last year. Exports climbed 13% year-on-year to EUR 1,786 million, boosted by higher sales to both EU countries (+16%) and non-EU countries (+17%). Exports rose for mineral products (+76%), raw materials and products of the chemical industry (+23%), machinery and mechanical appliances (+21%), miscellaneous manufactured articles (+15%), electrical equipment (+13%), and transport equipment (+11%). Imports jumped 12% to EUR 2,151 million on higher purchases from both EU (+11%) and non-EU (+10%) countries. Among commodities, notable increases were seen in mineral products (+69%), optical, measuring and precision instruments (+33%), machinery and mechanical appliances (+14%), and electrical equipment (+14%). Over the first four months of the year, the country recorded a trade shortfall of EUR 1,268 million, marginally higher than the EUR 1,259 million recorded in the same period of 2025.

New Zealand Stocks Close 1.3% Higher — The NZX 50 advanced 166 points, or 1.3%, to close at 13,204 on Tuesday, recovering from losses in the previous session and reaching its highest level since May 29, mainly boosted by gains in materials, industrials, healthcare, and energy stocks. The broader index rebounded from its lowest level since May 2025, touched a day earlier, tracking gains on Wall Street, where the Nasdaq and S&P 500 rose, buoyed by a rebound in chip stocks amid renewed optimism surrounding AI. Easing tensions in the Middle East also lifted sentiment after Iran and Israel indicated they had halted their exchanges of strikes. Positive economic data from China, New Zealand's largest trading partner, further supported sentiment by reinforcing confidence in the outlook for the Chinese economy. Among the top performers were Mainfreight (4.8%), Scales Corp. 【再熱蒸汽溫度達631攝氏度 “全球最燙”發電機組投產】6月8日，由東方電氣集團研發提供三大主機和關鍵輔機等裝置的世界首臺630攝氏度等級二次再熱超超臨界百萬千瓦煤電機組——大唐山東鄆城630攝氏度國家電力示範專案1號機組順利完成168小時滿負荷試執行，正式投入商業運營。這是目前全球溫度最高、壓力最高、效率最高、煤耗最低的煤電機組，為我國清潔高效煤電產業發展注入新動能。 該專案作為全球引數領先的百萬千瓦二次再熱機組，入選國家能源局第四批能源領域首臺（套）重大技術裝備名單。機組核心引數全面重新整理全球紀錄：再熱蒸汽溫度631攝氏度、主蒸汽壓力35.5兆帕、發電效率50.05%、發電煤耗低至245.74克/千瓦時。與常規百萬千瓦機組相比，該專案每年可節約標準煤約20.8萬噸，減少二氧化碳排放54萬噸。

【訊息人士：瑞士議員擬就瑞銀資本規則推出新折中方案】據媒體援引訊息人士報道，瑞士議員正考慮一項新提議，放寬對瑞銀的資本監管要求。該方案若落地，將大幅削減政府草案給這家銀行帶來的數十億美元合規壓力。瑞士政府今年4月向議會提交法案草案，擬出臺更嚴苛監管規定，避免瑞士信貸危機重演。草案要求瑞銀必須以一級核心資本（CET1）為其所有海外機構提供全額資本支援。2023年瑞士信貸倒閉後被瑞銀收購，瑞銀也成為瑞士目前僅剩的一家全球性銀行。該行此前批評這份監管草案要求“過於嚴苛”。四名知情人士透露，新折中方案擬將瑞銀海外子公司的一級核心資本支援比例下調至70%或80%，而非政府草案要求的100%。相關討論仍處於保密階段，上述訊息人士要求匿名。

Dutch May Inflation Confirmed at a Year High — The annual inflation rate in the Netherlands accelerated to 3.5% in May 2026 from 2.8% in April, confirming preliminary estimates and marking the highest reading since April last year. The main upward pressure came from higher transport inflation (9.9% vs 6.9% in April), primarily driven by increased costs of international flights, with airline tickets 12.3% more expensive than a year earlier. Price growth also picked up for housing (3.5% vs 3.3%), recreation and culture (2.8% vs 1.6%), and restaurants and accommodation (6.5% vs 3.9%). In contrast, inflation eased sharply for food and non-alcoholic beverages (0.1% vs 1.4%), while deflation persisted for household goods and services (-0.3% vs -0.4%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose just 0.1%, following a 1.1% jump in April, which was the largest increase in nine months. Meanwhile, annual HICP inflation, which excludes owner-occupied housing, picked up to 3.4% from 2.5% in April.

Dutch Household Spending Rises the Most in 6 Months — Household consumption in the Netherlands grew by 1% year-on-year in April 2026, following a 0.9% rise in the previous month. This marked the fastest growth since last October, driven largely by durable goods, which households purchased 4.9% more than a year earlier (vs 4.7% in March). Consumers primarily bought more cars, electrical appliances, and household furnishings. Households also consumed more food and beverages (0.9% vs -0.5%) and other goods, such as energy and personal care products (0.5% vs -1.4%). Meanwhile, expenditure on services, which accounts for more than half of total household consumption, edged down 0.1% (vs 0.4%), reflecting lower spending on accommodation and food services despite gains in transport and communication. Looking ahead, conditions for household spending appeared somewhat less unfavorable in May, supported largely by a stronger year-on-year increase in share prices.

Rupiah Remains Vulnerable — The Indonesian rupiah weakened to a near-record low of around IDR 18,170 per U.S. dollar on Tuesday, extending its losing streak to a sixth consecutive session. The drop came even as the U.S. dollar eased from a nine-week peak after Iran and Israel agreed to halt attacks, calming geopolitical tensions. Domestic strains kept pressure on the local currency, with May’s foreign reserves falling further, bond yields climbing, and import costs rising, underscoring external vulnerabilities. Concerns also deepened after reports that Washington may phase in an 18% tariff on Indonesian goods from July 24, threatening export competitiveness and capital flows. Traders largely shrugged off a sharp rise in tax revenue in the first five months of 2026, which officials touted as evidence of a stronger economy. The rupiah has now lost nearly 9% year-to-date, cementing its position as Asia’s weakest currency despite Bank Indonesia’s surprise 50bp rate hike to 5.25% in May, its first increase since 2022.

Sensex Rises on Financials Strength — India’s BSE Sensex rose about 0.3% to 73,726 in early trade on Tuesday, recovering from two consecutive sessions of losses as easing geopolitical tensions and supportive measures from the Reserve Bank of India boosted sentiment. Israel and Iran reportedly halted attacks on each other, easing fears of a broader regional conflict and pushing crude oil prices lower. Domestic sentiment was further supported after the RBI unveiled details of a concessional forex swap facility, allowing banks to hedge overseas borrowings of at least three years at lower cost. The measure is expected to reduce funding costs and enhance the appeal of foreign-currency borrowing for lenders. Financial stocks led the advance, with the banking and financial services indexes each gaining around 1%. Among financial names, BSE, ICICI, Canara, MCX, and Bajaj Finance gained between 1% and 2.6%, while IDFC and Master Trust climbed 4.1% and 4.7% respectively. On the downside, NLC (-3.9%), and Infosys (-1.2%) fell.

Coal Jumps as Indonesia Tightens Export Curbs — Thermal coal futures climbed above $150 per ton, reaching their highest level since September 2023 after Indonesia tightened export controls on commodities, a move expected to delay coal shipments from the country. The decision came amid stronger seasonal demand, with summer heat boosting electricity consumption for air conditioning. Ongoing disruptions linked to the Middle East conflict also continued to support coal prices, as the prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz forced Asian and European energy importers to seek alternatives to natural gas supplies from the Persian Gulf. Japan and South Korea, in particular, have increased their consumption of coal since the outbreak of the war. Qatar’s Ras Laffan facility has declared force majeure, removing nearly 10.2 Mtpa of LNG supply to Asia, with the partial shutdown expected to last through late summer.

【日執政黨批准安保三檔案修改建議書】日本自民黨今天（6月9日）召開總務會，批准了向政府提交的關於修改“安保三檔案”的建議草案。該草案要求確保實現“未來5年內防衛力量變革”所需的預算，不過沒有提出具體的防衛費增長目標，但列舉了以國內生產總值（GDP）3%至3.5%作為軍費開支目標的其他國家動向。該建議草案“敦促日本政府明確展現保衛國家的‘國家意志’”。 據此前訊息，該草案還提出強化防空體系和持續作戰能力——提出日本應儘早部署用於強化防空體系的攔截無人機和高功率定向能武器，並確保具備“至少以年為單位”持續作戰的能力。草案還提出應早日裝備搭載長射程導彈、配備下一代動力系統的潛艇，以強化“對敵基地攻擊能力”。 建議書沒有提及修改“無核三原則”或擁有核動力潛艇的問題，但明確提出要“進一步確保以美國核威懾力量為核心的延伸威懾的可信賴度”。 自民黨計劃於本月下旬將該建議草案提交給首相高市早苗。高市政府還將參考預計於今年秋季公佈的專家會議建議，並計劃於今年12月透過內閣會議正式決定新版“安保三檔案”。 “安保三檔案”是日本政府修訂的三份安保政策檔案，包括《國家安全保障戰略》、《國家防衛戰略》和《中期防衛力整備計劃》 。2022年，日本透過了“安保三檔案”，標誌著安保政策“由守轉攻”。“安保三檔案”是日本最高層級的安保戰略檔案，相當於日本安保政策的總綱領。

【習近平參訪朝鮮勞動黨中央幹部學校】當地時間6月9日上午，中共中央總書記、國家主席習近平在朝鮮勞動黨總書記、國務委員長金正恩陪同下，參訪位於平壤的朝鮮勞動黨中央幹部學校。 11時許，習近平乘車抵達。金正恩在學校標誌性建築朝鮮勞動黨象徵塔前迎接。數百名師生夾道歡迎，師生代表向習近平獻上鮮花。 在金正恩陪同下，習近平步入學校階梯教室。教室內學員整齊端坐，教員正在講授朝鮮對外關係課程中有關中朝關係的內容。中朝兩黨總書記到來時，師生們一起站立，向兩黨總書記報以熱烈的掌聲。習近平和金正恩駐足觀摩授課，不時頷首讚許。 離開階梯教室後，習近平和金正恩乘坐電瓶車參觀校園，沿途聽取有關學校基礎設施、教學安排等介紹。 來到教學樓之間的林地上，習近平和金正恩共同執鍬培土、提水澆灌，種下一株樅樹。樅樹四季常綠，象徵中朝友誼生生不息。隨後，在兩黨兩國最高領導人見證下，蔡奇和朝鮮勞動黨中央政治局常委、中央書記金才龍共同為植樹標識碑揭幕。碑身正面，用中朝雙語鐫刻著“中朝友誼萬古長青”幾個大字。在雙方陪同人員和朝方學員們的熱烈掌聲中，習近平和金正恩在植樹標識碑前握手合影。 蔡奇、王毅等參加上述活動。

Palm Oil Under Pressure Ahead of Monthly Data — Malaysian palm oil futures plunged by nearly 2% to below MYR 4,500 per tonne, reversing prior gains amid a firmer ringgit and weaker edible oils on the Dalian and Chicago markets. Traders also turned cautious ahead of the Malaysian Palm Oil Board’s monthly report due later this week, with expectations pointing to another inventory build in May. A Reuters survey suggested softer exports outweighed lower production, while cargo surveyors estimated shipments dropped 8.8%–15.5% from April. Demand from India, the world’s largest buyer, recovered modestly from April’s four-month low but remained below historical norms. Still, losses were cushioned by upbeat Chinese trade data, with exports hitting a record and imports accelerating in May, signaling resilient demand in a key market. Additional support came from top grower Indonesia, where new technical rules tightened oversight of strategic commodity exports, including palm oil, potentially shifting some demand toward Malaysian supplies.
【世界盃或分散交易員注意力 花旗稱賽期歐美債市波動通常減弱】 花旗表示，在世界盃舉行期間，美國和歐洲債券市場的波動往往減弱。隨著首場比賽將於週四開賽，該行重申其押注收益率曲線波動性下降的建議。“從歷史資料來看，世界盃期間美元和歐元短期利率波動率往往保持在低位，甚至進一步走低，支援了我們近期看跌波動率的預期，”其在6月8日的報告中寫道。

【習近平和彭麗媛參謁中朝友誼塔 】 當地時間6月9日上午，正在朝鮮進行國事訪問的中共中央總書記、國家主席習近平和夫人彭麗媛參謁中朝友誼塔。朝鮮勞動黨總書記、國務委員長金正恩和夫人李雪主陪同。10時40分許，習近平和彭麗媛乘車抵達坐落於牡丹峰麓的中朝友誼塔，金正恩和李雪主迎接。朝鮮軍樂隊奏響中朝兩國國歌。禮兵緩緩將花籃抬上平臺。花籃緞帶上寫著“中國人民志願軍烈士永垂不朽”。習近平緩步走上平臺，整理花籃緞帶。全體人員向中國人民志願軍烈士默哀。默哀畢，習近平和金正恩觀看儀仗隊分列式。習近平夫婦在金正恩夫婦陪同下步入友誼塔紀念廳。金正恩向習近平介紹了友誼塔內展現中國人民志願軍同朝鮮人民並肩浴血戰鬥、共同重建家園的史料、照片和油畫作品。習近平駐足良久，仔細觀看。習近平認真翻閱志願軍烈士名冊，向金正恩介紹犧牲的志願軍將士有關情況。習近平和金正恩一致認為，上世紀50年代中朝共同戰鬥的歲月是雙方永恆的歷史記憶，雙方要共同維護好志願軍烈士紀念設施，開展富有特色的革命傳統教育、青少年思想道德教育，讓偉大的抗美援朝精神發揚光大，讓偉大的中朝傳統友誼世代傳承。蔡奇、王毅等參加。（新華社）

【人形機器人政策加碼，創業板50ETF華安（159949）半日漲超2％成交13億！機構：夏日“陣雨”無礙二三季度新高】6月9日電，三大指數高開後震盪，創指、深成指均漲超1％。受此帶動，創業板50ETF華安（159949）漲2.16％，報1.892元，換手率5.76％，半日成交額13.18億元，居同類標的ETF首位。訊息面上，工業和資訊化部、國務院國資委聯合開展2026年度人形機器人與具身智慧實景實訓專項行動。到2026年底，人形機器人等重點產品在一批代表性場景中率先完成應用驗證和常態部署，開啟“作業模式”；凝練形成百個以上高價值應用場景，進一步豐富具身智慧應用譜系，帶動形成萬臺級規模落地能力。國泰海通證券認為，雖然海外局勢反覆或對國內交易側產生擾動，但夏日“陣雨”的衝擊不會太長，二三季度中國股市還會有不錯的表現，有望走出新高，四季度需要更穩健。　國信證券表示，目前A股市場震盪分化加速，科技主線資金分歧加大。總體而言，本輪交易擁擠度背後，是景氣度向科技、高階製造等方向集中的體現。科技景氣與產業趨勢未改，具備業績支撐的龍頭或將持續受益，有望成為穿越當前高位震盪格局的關鍵抓手。投資者可直接透過股票賬戶交易創業板50ETF華安（159949），也可透過聯接基金（A類：160422；C類：160424；I類：022654；Y類：022976）參與。

【紐西蘭首都遭遇強風巨浪 數百居民疏散】紐西蘭首都惠靈頓9日遭遇強風和巨浪襲擊，目前已有數百名居民疏散，渡輪服務和部分航班取消。據紐西蘭電臺報道，強風當天在惠靈頓南部海岸掀起11米巨浪。另據惠靈頓地區應急管理辦公室和當地媒體訊息，巨浪漫過沿海公路。惠靈頓機場風速接近每小時100公里，部分進出港航班取消，一架小型飛機被吹翻。區域性地區風速甚至達到每小時137公里。紐西蘭政府8日晚釋出強制疏散令，要求惠靈頓南部海岸居民撤離。惠靈頓南部和東部地區當晚也宣佈進入緊急狀態。據紐西蘭電臺報道，截至9日已有數百名居民撤離。此外，往返南北島的庫克海峽渡輪服務暫停。

【花旗：騰訊微信AI智慧體開發似乎進展順利】花旗分析師在一份研究報告中表示，騰訊微信AI智慧體的開發似乎進展順利。這款中國的全能應用週一邀請開發者將小程式整合到該應用的人工智慧生態系統中。花旗的分析師指出，初始測試階段包括美團、Tongcheng和攜程集團等關鍵合作伙伴，這將使使用者能夠直接透過嵌入該應用的AI智慧體獲取外賣等本地服務。他們表示，一旦完全整合，小程式將有資格被微信AI推薦和使用。他們指出：“我們認為，此次測試疊加來自Hy3模型的持續反饋，將為騰訊的下一次模型迭代提供寶貴資料。“
據美國媒體報道，一架美國陸軍“阿帕奇”武裝直升機8日在霍爾木茲海峽附近墜毀，兩名機組人員安全獲救。

【DeepSeek surges ~799% at listing; IDC job posting sparks GW-scale data center speculation】On June 9 morning DeepSeek opened at 63.65 yuan/share, up 799.01% at listing. The company’s BMS products are deployed in utility-scale high-voltage energy storage (power-side and grid-side), commercial and residential storage, and in backup-power BMS for data centers, telecom base stations and rail transit, linking it to AI infrastructure demand. AI-infrastructure names broadly rallied today (PCBs, electronic materials, silicon wafers). DeepSeek has posted an IDC design/planning engineer role on its website, prompting market speculation it may self-build a GW-scale data center.

【Tmall: number of new products surpassing 10 million yuan in 618 rises 60% YoY】Tmall data showed the number of new products launched during the 618 sale that rapidly exceeded 10 million yuan in sales rose 60% YoY. 【萬斯：美將推動同伊朗達成核協議 不管以色列是否願意】美國副總統萬斯8日表示，不管以色列是否願意，美國將繼續推動同伊朗達成協議。萬斯當天接受美國福克斯新聞頻道採訪時說，以色列和美國之間確實存在許多共同利益，“但我們也存在利益不一致的情況……以色列顯然有自己的目標，但美國對伊朗的首要目標是確保伊朗不擁有核武器”。他說，美國總統特朗普相信“能夠就伊朗核問題達成一項長期解決方案”，“以色列可能會喜歡這個方案，也可能不喜歡，但從根本上講，我們認為這最符合美國的利益”，“華盛頓將繼續追求這一目標”。（新華社）
【菲律賓南部強震已致37人死亡 】菲律賓民防局9日統計資料顯示，菲南部棉蘭老島附近海域8日發生的7.8級強震已造成至少37人死亡、約500人受傷。菲民防局說，地震引發的山體滑坡、建築坍塌和墜落物導致人員傷亡。據當地媒體報道，在受災嚴重的薩蘭加尼省，一處山體滑坡掩埋房屋，導致14人死亡。

【機構：2026年第一季度全球智慧手機銷量同比下滑5%，iOS市場份額達22%創歷年一季度新高】據Counterpoint諮詢，在市場環境持續承壓的背景下，2026年第一季度全球智慧手機銷量同比下滑5%。從作業系統層面的表現來看，能夠更深入地反映市場的底層變化趨勢。2026年第一季度，安卓系統全球市場份額降至73%，低於去年同期的76%，創下歷年第一季度份額新低。iOS市場份額達到22%，創下歷年一季度新高。HarmonyOS在中國市場份額回升至19%，扭轉了上季度的回落態勢，份額超越iOS。得益於Mate80系列與暢享90系列的市場表現，華為市場份額達到20%，創下自2020年第四季度以來的季度新高。

【伊朗官員：伊朗不排斥推進談判 但美必須拿出誠意】據美國方面8日訊息，伊朗伊斯蘭議會國家安全和外交政策委員會主席易卜拉欣·阿齊茲在接受採訪時說，原則上，伊朗並不排斥與美國推進和談，但美國必須改變目前的行事方式，拿出自己的誠意。阿齊茲說，伊美雙方在伊朗核計劃、鈾濃縮等主要問題上仍存在分歧，雙方之間仍缺乏信任。此外，美國最初承諾即刻解凍伊朗的被凍結資產，但時至今日，伊朗仍未看到美方有兌現承諾的動向。當被問及伊美兩國最終是否有可能達成和平協議時，阿齊茲說，答案取決於美方後續的實際行動。

【Iran says talks possible if US shows sincerity】According to US reports, Ebrahim Azizi, chair of Iran’s parliamentary national security and foreign policy committee, said in an interview that Iran does not in principle rule out advancing talks with the US but Washington must change its current approach and demonstrate sincerity. He said major differences remain on Iran’s nuclear programme and uranium enrichment and that mutual trust is lacking. Azizi said the US originally promised to immediately unfreeze Iranian assets but Tehran has seen no sign of that; whether a peace agreement is possible depends on subsequent US actions.

Rupee Rises on Softer Crude, Easing Tensions — The Indian rupee firmed to around 95.4 per dollar, pausing losses as easing geopolitical tensions and softer crude oil prices improved sentiment across Asian markets. A drop in global energy prices to about $91 per barrel eased concerns over India's import bill, while a weaker dollar supported the domestic currency. Investors also assessed the Reserve Bank of India's recent measures aimed at attracting foreign currency inflows. Demand for dollars from importers remained firm, but the rupee's rebound from recent lows and lower hedging costs reduced aggressive dollar buying, easing short-term pressure on the currency. Regional currencies advanced as reports of a pause in hostilities between Iran and Israel lifted risk appetite. However, investors remained cautious as elevated US Treasury yields, supported by expectations of prolonged restrictive Federal Reserve policy, could limit gains in emerging-market currencies.

China 10Y Yield Rebounds After Trade Data — China’s 10-year government bond yield rose toward 1.74% on Tuesday, rebounding from the previous session as investors remained cautious about the broader economic outlook despite stronger-than-expected trade data. Exports surged 19.4% year-on-year to a record USD 376.8 billion in May, supported by inventory accumulation to offset higher shipping and energy costs stemming from the Gulf conflict, and by AI-related product booms. While the conflict in the Middle East has not yet materially disrupted exports, signs of domestic economic slowdown continue to leave the country exposed to a global downturn. Imports rose 27.4% to USD 271.4 billion, beating forecasts of 25% as companies ramped up purchases of foreign chips and equipment. Consequently, China's trade surplus widened to USD 105.4 billion, its highest level since January. Meanwhile, China is due to launch a third tranche of 15 billion yuan-denominated bonds in Hong Kong on June 16.

【俄宣佈擊落95架無人機 摧毀烏多處軍事基礎設施】俄羅斯國防部8日釋出戰報說，俄防空兵當天在多地擊落95架烏克蘭無人機，俄軍還摧毀烏方多處軍事基礎設施。根據俄國防部透過社交媒體釋出的這份戰報，莫斯科時間8日14時至20時，俄防空兵在俄西部別爾哥羅德州、布良斯克州、卡盧加州、庫爾斯克州等多地及黑海上空攔截並摧毀95架烏方固定翼無人機。俄國防部還說，俄軍摧毀了烏克蘭武裝力量使用的多處彈藥庫、燃料庫、運輸及電力設施，以及烏軍部隊和外國僱傭兵的139個臨時部署點。此外，俄南部集團軍部隊當天採取行動，佔據頓涅茨克地區一處城鎮。（新華社）

【China issues national report on implementing New Urban Agenda】China's Ministry of Housing and Urban‑Rural Development, working with more than 40 ministries and agencies, released a national report in Beijing outlining China’s approach to implementing the New Urban Agenda under the UN 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda. The report concentrates on urbanization, housing security, green low‑carbon transition, and urban safety and resilience, and presents actions, measures and stated results across social, economic and environmental dimensions; the New Urban Agenda was adopted at UN Habitat III in October 2016 as the urban implementation framework of the 2030 Agenda.

Copper Steadies on Strong China Data — Copper futures steadied near $6.3 per pound on Tuesday after facing pressure in recent sessions, as solid trade data from top consumer China reinforced the demand outlook. Chinese exports jumped 19.4% to a record $376.8 billion in May, well above expectations, driven by strong demand for AI technology and renewable energy products. Copper also drew support from easing geopolitical tensions after Iran and Israel agreed to halt attacks against each other, reducing concerns that higher oil prices could fuel inflation and lead to tighter monetary policy that would weigh on global growth and metals demand. Meanwhile, Jefferies expects copper prices to remain stronger for longer than previously anticipated, citing an average annual supply deficit of 491,000 tons through 2030 and a delayed recovery at the Grasberg mine.

【中國發布落實《新城市議程》國家報告】從住房城鄉建設部獲悉，《以高質量城市發展助力落實聯合國2030年可持續發展議程——中國落實〈新城市議程〉國家報告》近日在京釋出，集中呈現了城市可持續發展的中國智慧和中國方案。這份《報告》由住房城鄉建設部會同40多個部門共同編寫形成，從社會、經濟和環境三個可持續發展維度，圍繞城鎮化、住房保障、綠色低碳轉型、安全韌性建設等多個方面，展現了中國推動城市可持續發展的行動、舉措與成效。據瞭解，《新城市議程》於2016年10月經聯合國第三次住房和城市可持續發展大會透過，是2030年可持續發展議程在城市領域的實施綱領和政治承諾，倡導建設包容、安全、韌性和可持續的城市和社群。10年來，中國採取系列務實行動推進落實，城市發展取得歷史性成就。據介紹，這份國家報告不僅總結了中國的經驗，也為廣大發展中國家推進可持續城市發展提供了有益借鑑，在另一個維度，報告還提出了人民城市、公園城市等先進理念，給其他國家的城市發展帶來不一樣的指導和借鑑。

【稅務資料顯示：2026年經營主體納稅繳費信用向好】2026年，稅務部門共對5466.9萬戶經營主體進行評價，較上年度增加490.3萬戶。評價結果顯示，我國經營主體納稅繳費信用持續向好。誠信納稅繳費經營主體數量穩步增長。全國守信經營主體達4711.1萬戶，同比增長8.6%。其中，納稅繳費信用級別最高的A級經營主體約788.4萬戶，佔比為14.4%。近千萬戶經營主體信用級別較上年度提高。971.7萬戶經營主體信用級別較上年度提升，同比增長44.1%。其中，439.6萬戶經營主體從B級升至A級，10.4萬戶從信用較低的C級提升至信用較高的B級。

【BYD's Wang Chuanfu: This year's sales will hinge on battery output; larger volumes expected next year】BYD Chairman Wang Chuanfu said second-generation blade batteries and flash-charging technology have resolved a major EV pain point and drawn strong domestic and international praise, but current battery capacity is still insufficient. Capacity is ramping by roughly 20,000-30,000 incremental units per month, he said, and the company is working around the clock to meet demand. Wang warned that vehicle sales this year will be determined by battery production. BYD will concentrate resources on its battery division to fully exploit blade-battery capacity and expects higher output later this year, with materially larger volumes next year once the ramp is complete and both domestic and international markets can be served.

【比亞迪王傳福：今年的銷量將取決於電池產量，更大的產量將在明年】6月9日，比亞迪董事長兼總裁王傳福在股東大會上表示，今天有約一千人參與股東大會，創歷史新高。王傳福表示，二代刀片電池和閃充技術解決了電動化一大痛點，受到了來自國內外的很高評價。但他直言目前產能還不夠，產能正在以每月兩萬到三萬的增量在爬升，公司正在夜以繼日奮鬥應對挑戰。他透露，今年公司的銷量將取決於電池的產量。公司將聚焦電池事業部、配置資源，把刀片電池的產能充分挖掘出來。“那麼隨著我們電池的產能提升，相信今年會有很好的產量。更大的產量將會在明年，明年我們的產能一旦爬坡好以後，相信國內國際兩個市場將同時發力。”王傳福表示。（澎湃新聞）
【水利部：廣西、廣東、福建、江西15條河流發生超警洪水】從水利部瞭解到，受降雨影響，昨天到今天，廣西柳江上游幹流、賀江上游幹流，廣東北江上游支流羅壩水、東江上游支流大信河，福建九龍江、閩江上游沙溪支流東溪及中游支流尤溪，江西贛江上游支流桃江等15條河流發生超警洪水，最大超警幅度1.12米，目前大部已退至警戒水位以下。

【China midday: Shanghai Composite up 0.51%; semiconductors, MLCC lead gains】By midday Shanghai Composite rose 0.51%, Shenzhen Composite 1.25% and ChiNext 1.91%. Semiconductors led gains; several chip-related names hit daily limits, and MLCC stocks rebounded with multiple limit-ups. PCB names outperformed, with some stocks at limit-up and international composite materials jumping over 13%. Other strong segments included memory chips, advanced packaging, lithography resist, CPO, OLED and liquid-cooling. Lagging sectors included coal, oilfield services & engineering, tax-refund retail, sports, baijiu, property developers and shipping/ports. Turnover on the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was about 1.61 trillion yuan at mid-session, down roughly 159.5 billion yuan from yesterday; about 2,500 stocks advanced and 2,900 declined.

【瑞銀亞洲ESG團隊據報人數減半，公司回應：正將可持續發展職能融入集團】據香港經濟日報，瑞銀集團（UBS）完成與瑞信的整合後，一直在縮減其環境、社會和治理（ESG）職能。有訊息稱，作為全球重組計劃的一部分，瑞銀已大幅削減其亞洲可持續發展辦公室的規模，近幾個月來該部門員工已減少一半。據悉，瑞銀可持續發展辦公室的全球員工人數已從2023年年中的100多人縮減至約35人。瑞銀發言人未就具體裁員情況置評，僅在宣告中表示，將瑞銀定位為可持續發展領導者的目標並未改變，目前正將可持續發展職能融入整個集團，以加強執行力、提高生產效率、避免重複工作，並以規模化方式支援客戶和各項業務。
【汽輪科技：公司燃氣輪機產品不能用於飛行汽車渦輪增壓應用場景】汽輪科技6月9日在互動平臺回覆稱，公司燃氣輪機產品主要用於分散式發電領域，不能用於飛行汽車渦輪增壓的應用場景。

【午評：科創50指數半日漲2.98%，算力硬體股集體反彈】A股三大指數早盤集體上漲，截至午盤，上證指數漲0.51%，深證成指漲1.25%，創業板指漲1.91%，北證50漲0.05%，科創50指數漲2.98%。全市場成交額16310億元，較上日縮量1643億元，全市場超2900只個股下跌。板塊題材上，電子化學品、半導體、光刻膠、元件、PCB、儲存晶片板塊漲幅居前；油氣開採及服務、煤炭開採加工、白酒、電機、房地產板塊跌幅居前。盤面上，半導體板塊高開高走持續走強，滬矽產業、西安奕材、傑華特等多股漲停，富創精密、宏微科技、恆運昌、有研矽、江豐電子漲幅居前。PCB概念板塊表現強勢，雅葆軒30cm漲停，另有金安國紀、聖泉集團等十餘股漲停，金太陽、瑞華泰、南亞新材漲幅居前。光刻膠板塊震盪走強，世名科技盤中觸及20cm漲停，東材科技漲停，飛凱材料、艾森股份、聯合化學漲幅居前。油氣開採及服務低開低走，通源石油、潛能恆信、中曼石油、科力股份、中油工程跌幅居前。煤炭開採加工板塊調整，鄭州煤電、大有能源、陝西黑貓領跌板塊。房地產板塊亦表現疲軟，南山控股、榮安地產盤中觸及跌停，榮豐控股、京能置業、光大嘉寶跌幅居前。

Offshore Yuan Holds Gains on Strong Exports — The offshore yuan held its gains around 6.78 per dollar on Tuesday, as stronger-than-expected trade data highlighted the resilience of China's export sector despite signs of an economic slowdown. Exports surged 19.4% year-on-year to a record USD 376.8 billion in May, driven by inventory building aimed at mitigating rising shipping and energy costs linked to the Gulf conflict, alongside robust demand for semiconductors and AI-related products. While the Middle East conflict has yet to significantly affect exports, weak domestic demand continues to leave the economy vulnerable to a deterioration in global conditions, reinforcing expectations for further policy easing. Meanwhile, imports jumped 27.4% to USD 271.4 billion, beating forecasts of a 25% increase and suggesting that domestic demand held up well despite rising inflationary pressures. Consequently, China's trade surplus widened to USD 105.4 billion, its highest level since January.

【國家廣播電視總局：一季度全國廣播電視服務業總收入同比增長8.55%】國家廣播電視總局釋出2026年一季度廣播電視服務業主要資料情況，經初步統計，一季度，全國廣播電視服務業總收入3562.38億元，同比增長8.55%。其中，實際創收收入3174.97億元，同比增長10.85%。按主體分，廣播電視機構總收入1565.13億元，網路視聽服務機構總收入1997.25億元。全國廣播節目播出時間382.45萬小時，電視節目播出時間450.66萬小時。截至3月末，全國有線電視實際使用者2.05億戶，廣電5G使用者近4300萬戶。

【國家電投今年以來已會談十餘個省市 黑龍江提出算電協同等合作意向】6月7日，國家電投集團總經理徐樹彪在哈爾濱拜會黑龍江省委副書記、省長梁惠玲，就深化能源領域合作，共同推動黑龍江振興發展進行交流。今年以來，國家電投已先後與內蒙古、青海、河南、海南、甘肅、吉林、廣西壯族自治區防城港市、內蒙古自治區錫林郭勒盟、廣東省湛江市、廣東橫琴粵澳深度合作區等省、市舉行工作會談，就共同謀劃“十五五”時期重點合作專案等開展交流。其中，黑龍江願與國家電投集團一道，深化央地合作，在服務國家戰略中實現共贏發展。佈局建設重型燃機專案，深度參與黑龍江算電協同試點、零碳園區建設，積極開發生物質秸稈和畜禽糞汙資源化利用專案。

【中國代表就俄烏局勢提出四點期待】據CCTV國際時訊，當地時間6月8日下午，北京時間今天（6月9日）凌晨，聯合國安理會審議烏克蘭問題。中國常駐聯合國副代表孫磊表示，烏克蘭危機仍在延宕，衝突烈度持續上升，局勢呈螺旋式升級。戰場相關的數字每天都在變化，新的襲擊、新的傷亡、新的設施損毀不斷出現，但有一個事實始終不變——軍事手段無法帶來和平，衝突延續下去只會造成更嚴重的傷害。中方在烏克蘭問題上始終秉持客觀公正立場，將繼續同國際社會一道，為實現危機的政治解決發揮積極作用。中方結合當前形勢提出四點期待：期待當事方以人民為重，保持最大程度剋制，防止局勢滑向不可控的方向；期待有關各方早日恢復和談程序，爭取達成全面、持久、有約束力的和平協議；期待地區國家和國際社會發出更多停火止戰、勸和促談的理性聲音；期待有關各方在充分、完全遵循《聯合國憲章》原則的基礎上，致力於解決危機根源問題，構建均衡、有效、可持續的地區安全架構。

【歐盟對原產於中國的脂肪族-芳香族共聚酯發起反傾銷調查】歐盟委員會發布公告稱，應歐盟企業BASF於2026年4月20日提出的申請，對原產於中國的脂肪族-芳香族共聚酯（Aliphatic-aromatic Copolyesters）發起反傾銷調查，具體產品包括聚對苯二甲酸-己二酸丁二醇酯（PBAT）和聚癸二酸丁二醇酯—對苯二甲酸丁二醇酯（PBSeT）產品。涉案產品的歐盟CN（Combined Nomenclature）編碼為3907 99 80（TARIC編碼為3907 99 80 50）。本案傾銷調查期為2025年1月1日至2025年12月31日，損害調查期為2022年1月1日至傾銷調查期結束。

【韓國與SK海力士股票掛鉤的槓桿ETF上演“反向”暴漲暴跌 引發投資者質疑】韓國一隻與SK海力士掛鉤的槓桿ETF連續第二天劇烈波動，該ETF在週一飆升近50%之後，週二早盤又一度暴跌40%，與SK海力士的股價表現背離，引發投資者質疑。SK海力士股價週一下跌近8%，週二盤中最高上漲8.7%。按照KIM ACE SK Hynix Single Stock Leverage ETF旨在提供SK海力士日回報率兩倍的設計，週二本應錄得約17%的漲幅。連續兩日的反向異動把管理該ETF的韓國投資基金管理公司推到風口浪尖。該公司聲稱週一的異常表現源於其做市系統流動性不足。這引發了投資者對於韓國快速增長的單個股票槓桿ETF市場定價可靠性的質疑。

【韓國內閣批准關於3500億美元對美投資計劃的法令】韓國內閣週二批准了一項總統令，這是推進韓美兩國去年達成的貿易協議中3500億美元對美戰略投資計劃的一部分。該法令明確了投資計劃中的若干條款和條件，包括對“商業合理性”的定義。該定義將成為對美國戰略性產業進行2000億美元直接投資的依據。韓國還同意在造船相關合作領域投資1500億美元，以換取更優惠的關稅待遇。首爾方面將“具有商業合理性的專案”定義為：在專案預計週期內，能夠產生足夠收入以完全覆蓋投資本金及利息成本的專案。宣告稱，各專案的期限將透過與華盛頓的談判來確定。韓國還將設立一家由國家支援的投資公司，運營期限為20年。根據與華盛頓達成的貿易協議，韓國承諾實施該投資計劃，以此換取美國降低對包括汽車在內的韓國輸美商品的關稅。

Platinum Holds at 6-Month Low — Platinum futures held around $1,760 an ounce, staying at their lowest level since December 2025, pressured by broader weakness across precious metals despite a halt in Middle East tensions. Israel and Iran both agreed to halt mutual attacks after an earlier escalation in hostilities, raising hopes of a possible restart of talks toward a broader ceasefire agreement in the region. However, the crucial Strait of Hormuz remained effectively closed, keeping energy supplies constrained and global inflation risks in focus. A stronger dollar and elevated Treasury yields also weighed on non-yielding metals after robust US jobs data reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates by year-end. Meanwhile, platinum’s downside was partly cushioned by a widening supply deficit, with the World Platinum Investment Council projecting a fourth consecutive annual shortfall in 2026, driven by constrained production from major producers, while industrial demand remained resilient.

【古巴附近海域發生6.2級地震】古巴國家地震研究中心8日說，古巴附近海域當日發生6.2級地震。首都哈瓦那、比那爾德里奧省等多地有震感，暫無人員傷亡報告。 地震發生於當地時間8日14時（北京時間9日2時），震中位於比那爾德里奧省曼圖亞市西北約100公里處，震源深度10公里。報告有震感的地區還包括阿特米薩省、馬亞韋克省、馬坦薩斯省及青年島。 古巴共產黨中央機關報《格拉瑪報》報道說，這是古巴西部有地震記錄以來最強的一次地震。1880年，該地區曾發生6級地震。(新華社)

New Zealand Dollar Attempts to Rise — The New Zealand dollar traded around $0.581, attempting to rise from a two-month low, as risk sentiment improved following a recent concession of strikes in the Middle East. Israel and Iran both agreed to halt mutual attacks after an earlier escalation in violence, raising hopes of a possible restart of talks toward a broader ceasefire agreement in the region. Meanwhile, the Kiwi dollar remained supported by expectations of central bank tightening, as the Reserve Bank has recently taken a more hawkish turn. Following the central bank’s split decision to hold rates in late May, policymakers signaled that interest rates could rise earlier and by a larger-than-expected margin to offset the impact of the energy shock. Markets now imply a chance that the RBNZ will lift its 2.25% cash rate by a quarter point at its next meeting on July 8 and peak around 3.50% late next year.

China Trade Surplus Largest in 4 Months — China’s trade surplus widened to USD 105.43 billion in May 2026 from USD 102.72 billion in the same period of 2025, surpassing expectations of USD 92.1 billion. It was the largest trade surplus since January, as both exports and imports surged. Export growth accelerated to 19.4%, reaching a record high of USD 376.78 billion, up from April’s 14.1% rise and exceeding forecasts of 15%, as companies continued to build inventories to pre-empt energy price pressures stemming from the ongoing war in the Middle East. Meanwhile, imports jumped 27.4% yoy to USD 271.35 billion, above expectations of 25%, and accelerated from 25.3% growth in April amid the government's efforts to boost domestic consumption. China’s trade surplus with the US increased to USD 26.02 billion in May. For the first five months of 2026, China’s trade surplus reached USD 451.71 billion, down from USD 471.9 billion in the same period of 2025, as exports increased 15.5% while imports rose at a faster pace of 24.5%.

China Imports Rise More than Expected — China’s imports soared 27.4% yoy to USD 271.35 billion in May 2026, accelerating from a 25.3% growth in the prior month and topping market forecasts of 25%. It was the 12th straight month of growth in purchases, boosted by solid domestic demand despite rising inflationary pressures from supply chain disruptions and elevated energy costs due to the war in the Middle East. Over the first six months of the year, imports jumped 24.5% to USD 1,261.69 billion, boosted by higher demand from the ASEAN countries (21.0%), the EU (8.6%), Japan (27.8%), Hong Kong (173.2%), and South Korea (56.5%), but fell from the U.S. (-5.5%). Imports of data processing equipment surged 65.1%, while purchases of semiconductors and integrated circuits each rose by 11.5% and 52.1%, respectively. Volume increases were seen for edible oils (24.2%), copper ore (36.7%), refined oil (6.74%), rare earths (40.6%), and unwrought copper (26.1%), but declined for natural gas (-10.1%), coal (-2.9%), and steel (-8.5%).

China Exports Hit New Record High — China’s exports surged 19.4% year-on-year to a record high of USD 376.78 billion in May 2026, far exceeding forecasts of 15% and accelerating sharply from April’s 14.1% rise. It was the fastest increase since February, as companies continued to build inventories to pre-empt energy price pressures stemming from the ongoing war in the Middle East. For the first five months of the year, total exports still rose 15.5% year-on-year to USD 1.71 trillion. During the period, exports increased to ASEAN countries (20.3%), the EU (16.4%), Hong Kong (45.5%), South Korea (28.5%), and Japan (7.1%), but declined to the US (-2.7%).

South Korean Won Strengthens on Dollar Selling — The South Korean won strengthened to around 1,518 per dollar, recovering further after touching its weakest level since March 2009 near 1,560, as authorities and large institutional players stepped up dollar supply to stabilise the currency. State-run National Pension Service reportedly conducted FX hedging, boosting onshore dollar selling, while policymakers continued verbal warnings against excessive volatility and closely monitored market activity. Additional support came from improved risk sentiment after Israel and Iran agreed to a ceasefire, easing demand for safe-haven assets. Continued strength in semiconductor exports and an upward revision to first-quarter GDP growth to 1.8% further supported the won through improved growth and external balance expectations. However, gains were tempered by a firm US dollar as markets reassessed expectations for Federal Reserve easing amid resilient US economic data.

Australia 10Y Yield Stays at 2-Week High — Australia’s 10-year government bond yield held above 4.9%, trading near a two-week high as markets weighed easing Middle East tensions while persistent cost-of-living pressures weighed on domestic sentiment. Household confidence deteriorated further into deep pessimism, with the Westpac–Melbourne Institute Consumer Sentiment Index falling about 3% to 80.6 in June, marking the fourth decline this year and among the weakest in decades. Elevated living costs remain a key drag on household finances, while a temporary fuel tax cut provided only limited and short-lived support. Attention is now focused on the upcoming policy decision from the Reserve Bank of Australia next week, with markets broadly expecting rates to be left unchanged. Meanwhile, global risk sentiment got a minor lift after Iran and Israel announced a halt in fighting. However, a peace deal has yet to be reached and the Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed, keeping global inflation risks in focus.

Indonesia Shares Rebound from Near 6-Year Low — Indonesia’s IDX Composite bounced back 64 points or 1.2% to 5,405 in early Tuesday trade, halting a five-session slide as bargain hunters stepped in after the index touched its weakest level since November 2020 in the prior session. The recovery came despite lingering geopolitical tensions, domestic macro pressures, and concerns over external buffers. Sentiment brightened after reports showed that tax revenue surged in the first five months of 2026, a development the government hailed as evidence of economic recovery. Meanwhile, Bank Indonesia also noted strong growth in adjusted base money (M0), which expanded by over 14% for a second straight month. Gains were broad-based, led by basic materials, infrastructure, and industry. Standout movers included Telkom Indonesia (10.2%), Sumber Alfaria Trijaya (6.9%), Aneka Tambang (4.0%), and Bank Tabungan Negara (2.4%). Traders now look to May trade data from China, Indonesia's largest trading partner, due later today, for further cues.

【索馬利亞裁判被美拒絕入境無緣世界盃】國際足聯當地時間6月8日證實，美國於上週末拒絕讓索馬利亞裁判奧馬爾·阿卜杜勒卡迪爾·阿爾坦入境。原本他有望成為首位執法世界盃比賽的索馬利亞人。 據報道，被評為“2025年非洲足聯最佳男裁判”的阿爾坦持有效簽證。索馬利亞駐美國使館暫未回應置評請求。 國際足聯發言人表示，“國際足聯不參與東道國的移民程式，包括簽證裁決。我們已收到通知，阿爾坦被拒絕入境這一結果無法更改。” 美國海關與邊境保護局在一份宣告中稱，“一名索馬利亞公民於6月6日從土耳其伊斯坦布林抵達美國邁阿密國際機場，因‘審查方面的顧慮’被認定不符合入境條件。”該宣告未詳細說明具體顧慮為何。 在特朗普政府嚴格的移民政策背景下，本屆世界盃開賽前的入境問題一直備受關注。去年，美國對包括索馬利亞在內的12個國家實施了廣泛的旅行禁令。（CCTV國際時訊）

US 10-Year Yield Holds Firm — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note held around 4.57% on Tuesday, hovering near a two-week high as stronger-than-expected US jobs data reinforced expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike by year-end. Markets are now pricing in roughly a 70% chance of a quarter-point rate increase in December, though the central bank is still widely expected to leave rates unchanged later this month. Investors are now turning their attention to US CPI and PPI data due later this week for further clues on the Fed’s policy path. Meanwhile, Iran and Israel agreed to halt attacks against each other, weighing on oil prices and easing inflation concerns. President Donald Trump also said both sides were seeking an immediate ceasefire and that final negotiations were moving forward.

Notable decliners included AIA (-1.6%), Lenovo (-0.3%), Knowledge Atlas Technology (-7.8%), and Xiaomi (-1.2%). In contrast, Tencent advanced 3.4% and Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation gained 0.9%, helping the benchmark recover from earlier losses. Investors also remained cautious amid persistent concerns over the pace of China's economic recovery and ahead of the country's trade balance data due later.

【厄瓜多議長和外長辭職】厄瓜多國民代表大會主席（議長）尼爾斯·奧爾森8日宣佈辭職。此前一天，厄外交和移民事務部長加夫列拉·索默費爾德宣佈辭職。 奧爾森在議會全體會議上宣佈辭職，並表示“這是我個人作出的決定”。 奧爾森於2025年5月當選議長。他辭職後，厄議會第一副主席米歇爾·曼切諾將接任。 索默費爾德7日說，因個人原因決定辭去外長職務。索默費爾德自2023年起擔任厄外長。 厄瓜多將於年底舉行地方選舉。多家厄主流媒體此前報道說，奧爾森和索默費爾德被視為角逐瓜亞斯省省長、首都基多市市長的熱門人選。(新華社)

Australian Dollar Stays at 2-Month Low — The Australian dollar rose above $0.705, but stayed at a two-month low as investors assessed easing Middle East tensions while persistent cost-of-living pressures weighed on domestic sentiment. Household confidence deteriorated further into deep pessimism, with the Westpac–Melbourne Institute Consumer Sentiment Index falling about 3% to 80.6 in June, marking the fourth decline this year and among the weakest in decades. Households reported ongoing strain from elevated living costs, while a temporary fuel tax cut offered only limited and short-lived relief. Against this backdrop, investors are turning their attention to the upcoming policy decision from the Reserve Bank of Australia next week, where rates are widely expected to be held steady. Meanwhile, global risk sentiment got a minor lift after Iran and Israel announced a halt in fighting. However, the safe-haven US dollar remained stronger amid uncertainty over a US-Iran peace deal and hawkish Fed bets after a robust US jobs data.

European Gas Prices Ease — European Gas Prices Ease European natural gas dipped to around €50 per megawatt hour, following an over 3% gain in the previous session, as Israel and Iran agreed to halt mutual attacks after a recent escalation in hostilities. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel is temporarily pausing strikes on Iran but would respond if Tehran resumes hostilities, while Iranian media indicated a similar stance. The development sustained hopes for a possible restart of talks toward a wider ceasefire agreement in the Middle East. Still, heightened uncertainty persisted, while the Strait of Hormuz, through which around one-fifth of global LNG flows, remained largely constrained, posing a challenge for importing regions as disruptions tightened global supply and increased competition for cargoes. This raised concerns about Europe’s ability to rebuild gas inventories ahead of winter.

China Stocks Rebound as Trade Data Looms — The Shanghai Composite rose 0.2% to 3,965 on Tuesday, while the Shenzhen Component advanced 1.2%, with both benchmarks rebounding from the previous session's losses as investors looked ahead to key trade data due later in the day. Market expectations point to a trade surplus of $92.1 billion, with export growth accelerating to 15% year-on-year from 14.1% in April, while imports are forecast to eased to 25%, from 25.3%. Sentiment was further supported by growing optimism over potential de-escalation in the Middle East after Iran and Israel agreed to suspend hostilities. Both benchmarks also drew support from a rebound in heavyweight technology shares following a slump in the prior session, led by Zhongji Innolight (2%), Eoptolink Technology (3.5%), and NAURA Technology (3.6%). Gains were also seen in Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (2.2%), PetroChina (3.2%), and China Shenhua Energy (4.6%).

【最高法釋出首個專門規範植物新品種審判領域技術事實查明的指導性檔案】從最高人民法院獲悉，最高人民法院近日印發《人民法院審理植物新品種案件技術事實查明工作指引》（以下簡稱《指引》），並同步釋出三個植物新品種案件技術事實查明典型案例，進一步規範人民法院審理植物新品種權民事和行政糾紛案件技術事實查明工作，提高技術事實查明的科學性、準確性、規範性，以更符合科學規律的事實查明和更具針對性的法律標準，有力保障有關案件公正高效審理。最高法公佈資料顯示，2019年至2025年，全國法院新收植物新品種一審案件4521件，二審案件987件；法庭共受理植物新品種案件923件，審結725件。其中，2025年全國法院新收一審案件1402件，同比增長57.4%；法庭新收264件，同比增長48.3%。

【檢察機關依法對韓松涉嫌受賄案提起公訴】從最高人民檢察院獲悉，陝西省西安市人大常委會原黨組書記、主任韓松涉嫌受賄一案，由國家監察委員會調查終結，移送檢察機關審查起訴。最高人民檢察院依法以涉嫌受賄罪對韓松作出逮捕決定，並指定由甘肅省蘭州市人民檢察院審查起訴。近日，蘭州市人民檢察院已向蘭州市中級人民法院提起公訴。檢察機關在審查起訴階段，依法告知了被告人韓松享有的訴訟權利，並訊問了被告人，聽取了辯護人的意見。檢察機關起訴指控：被告人韓松利用擔任原國家工商行政管理總局宣傳中心主任兼辦公廳副主任，陝西省西安市委常委、副市長，西安國際港務區管委會黨工委書記、主任，西安市委副書記、政法委書記，西安市人大常委會黨組書記、主任等職務上的便利，為他人謀取利益，以及利用本人職權或者地位形成的便利條件，透過其他國家工作人員職務上的行為，為他人謀取不正當利益，非法收受他人財物，數額特別巨大，依法應當以受賄罪追究其刑事責任。
【烏克蘭獲得歐盟28億歐元金融援助】烏克蘭財政部8日在官網釋出訊息稱，烏方獲得歐盟28億歐元金融援助。算上此次援助，烏方已從歐盟獲得295億歐元援助。烏財政部稱，這28億歐元援助將優先用於國家財政支出，尤其是滿足社會和人道主義需求。（新華社）

【德媒：德法決定停止聯合研發戰鬥機】據多家德國媒體8日報道，因合作企業間分歧難以彌合，德國和法國已決定停止“未來空中作戰系統”框架下的戰鬥機聯合研發專案。 德國電視一臺《今日新聞》欄目網站援引政府知情人士的話說，德國總理默茨與法國總統馬克龍已達成共識，專案合作方法國達索公司與代表德國、西班牙兩國利益的空中客車公司未能在聯合研製戰鬥機問題上達成一致。默茨向馬克龍提議叫停該戰鬥機研發計劃。 報道說，雖然聯合研發被叫停，但德法兩國仍計劃繼續推進該框架下的“戰鬥雲”系統開發。該系統旨在透過網路將各種武器系統、平臺和感測器進行連線。 德法兩國於2017年宣佈將聯合研發包括下一代戰機等在內的“未來空中作戰系統”，西班牙之後加入。該專案曾被視為歐洲防務合作的標誌性專案，然而，達索與空客在專案主導權等方面存在嚴重分歧，專案進展受阻。(新華社)

South Korean Shares Rebound on AI Optimism — The benchmark KOSPI rose more than 3% to around 7,720 on Tuesday, recovering part of the previous session's selloff, as technology stocks rebounded and investors remained optimistic about the long-term outlook for artificial intelligence. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang called the recent semiconductor selloff a buying opportunity, while Nvidia deepened partnerships with major South Korean firms and SK hynix moved to expand HBM4 production capacity. Samsung Electronics (2.5%) and SK Hynix (5.9%) led the advance, alongside SK Square (4.2%), Kia Corporation (7.9%), and Doosan Enerbility (3.9%). Additional support came from improved risk sentiment after Israel and Iran agreed to a ceasefire. South Korea's first-quarter GDP growth was also revised higher to 1.8%, supported by robust semiconductor exports and solid investment. However, gains were limited by expectations that strong growth and inflation pressures could keep interest rates higher for longer.

Australia Business Sentiment Improves — Australia’s NAB Business Confidence Index rose to -14 in May from -24 in the prior month, marking its highest print since February and signaling modest improvement from very weak levels. Confidence, however, remained firmly negative, underscoring concerns over the economic outlook. Business conditions held at 3, halting a four-month slide as activity stabilized despite softer demand. Profitability stayed the weakest component relative to long-run norms, reflecting margin strain from elevated costs. Cost growth eased but remained historically high, while capacity utilisation slipped below 82% for the first time since early 2025, pointing to softer momentum. NAB economist Michael Hayes noted sentiment was negative across industries amid global uncertainty, a weakening domestic backdrop, and persistent cost pressures. Firms also face high borrowing costs after the central bank lifted rates to 4.35% to curb sticky inflation and prevent rising energy costs from feeding into consumer prices.

Dollar Eases as Iran and Israel Halt Strikes — The dollar index slipped below 100 on Tuesday, pulling back from a nine-week high after Iran and Israel agreed to halt attacks against each other, easing safe-haven demand for the greenback. President Donald Trump also said both sides were seeking an immediate ceasefire and that final negotiations were moving forward. Despite the decline, the dollar remained near multi-month highs against its major peers as stronger-than-expected US jobs data reinforced expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike by year-end. Markets are now pricing in roughly a 70% chance of a quarter-point rate increase in December. Investors are also awaiting US CPI and PPI data later this week for further clues on the Fed’s policy outlook.
